name.ka: ჩინეთის მთავრობის სტიპენდია საქართველოს მოქალაქეებისთვის 2027–28 (IEC)

duration.ar: درجة كاملة (بكالوريوس أو ماجستير أو دكتوراه) أو سنة لغة/بحث

deadline_note: Estimated: the IEC nomination round for Chinese Government Scholarships runs every year; the 2025-26 round accepted applications 15 Nov – 10 Feb. The 2027-28 call is expected on iec.gov.ge in November 2026.

summary.en: Georgia's International Education Center nominates Georgian citizens for full Chinese Government (CSC) scholarships at bachelor's, master's and PhD level. Tuition, housing, medical insurance and a monthly stipend are covered.
summary.ka: განათლების საერთაშორისო ცენტრი ყოველწლიურად წარადგენს საქართველოს მოქალაქეებს ჩინეთის მთავრობის (CSC) სრულ სტიპენდიაზე ბაკალავრიატში, მაგისტრატურასა და დოქტორანტურაში. სტიპენდია ფარავს სწავლის საფასურს, საცხოვრებელს, დაზღვევასა და ყოველთვიურ ანაზღაურებას.
summary.ar: يرشّح مركز التعليم الدولي في جورجيا مواطنين جورجيين لمنح الحكومة الصينية الكاملة (CSC) في مراحل البكالوريوس والماجستير والدكتوراه. وتغطي المنحة الرسوم الدراسية والسكن والتأمين الصحي وراتبًا شهريًا.

about.en:
The Chinese Government Scholarship is offered to Georgia under the 2001 education cooperation agreement between the two ministries of education. Georgia's International Education Center (IEC) runs the national competition and nominates candidates to the China Scholarship Council, which places them at Chinese universities.

The programme covers bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees, general/senior visiting-scholar research stays and Chinese-language courses. Programmes are taught in English or Chinese depending on the university. Candidates must apply in two systems: the IEC portal (app.iec.gov.ge) and the CSC portal (campuschina.org).

It is one of the few fully funded routes to a complete undergraduate degree abroad for Georgian school leavers, and the IEC holds weekly consultations in Tbilisi during the application window.

en: Full tuition, campus housing, insurance and monthly stipend paid by the Chinese Government
Bachelor's, master's, PhD and language/research tracks
National nomination by Georgia's IEC: you compete only against other Georgian applicants

eligibility.en: Citizens of Georgia (and holders of Georgian status-neutral ID/travel documents). Academic requirements and age limits follow the CSC rules for each degree level (e.g. under 25 for bachelor's, under 35 for master's, under 40 for PhD). English- or Chinese-taught programmes; language proof as required by the host university.

en: Watch iec.gov.ge (Programmes → 2026-2027 / 2027-2028) for the call, usually published in November.
Register on app.iec.gov.ge and fill in the motivation letter (in Georgian), CV and referee form.
Complete the CSC online application at campuschina.org (agency number for Georgia given in the call) and print the foreign physical examination form.
Upload passport, diplomas/transcripts and any social-status documents before the deadline.
Shortlisted candidates may be interviewed by IEC; nominees then wait for CSC/university admission in summer.

costs.en: Covered by the Chinese Government: tuition, university accommodation, comprehensive medical insurance and a monthly stipend (CNY 2,500 bachelor's / 3,000 master's / 3,500 PhD under current CSC rates). Airfare is normally not covered.

score_reason: Fully funded degree in China with a Georgia-only nomination round

name.ka: ყაზახეთის რესპუბლიკის სასტიპენდიო პროგრამა საქართველოს მოქალაქეებისთვის 2027–28
name.ar: منحة حكومة كازاخستان لمواطني جورجيا 2027–2028 (عبر مركز التعليم الدولي)

duration.en: Full bachelor's, master's or PhD programme
duration.ka: სრული საბაკალავრო, სამაგისტრო ან სადოქტორო პროგრამა
duration.ar: برنامج كامل للبكالوريوس أو الماجستير أو الدكتوراه

deadline_note: Estimated from the 2025-26 round (applications by e-mail 24 April – 29 May 2025). The 2027-28 call is expected on iec.gov.ge in spring 2027.

summary.en: A bilateral scholarship that funds tuition and living costs for Georgian citizens studying a full degree at Kazakh universities. A handful of places are offered each year at bachelor's, master's and PhD level.
summary.ka: ორმხრივი სასტიპენდიო პროგრამა, რომელიც აფინანსებს საქართველოს მოქალაქეების სწავლასა და ცხოვრების ხარჯებს ყაზახეთის უნივერსიტეტებში. ყოველწლიურად რამდენიმე ადგილი გამოიყოფა ბაკალავრიატში, მაგისტრატურასა და დოქტორანტურაში.
summary.ar: منحة ثنائية تموّل الدراسة وتكاليف المعيشة لمواطني جورجيا الذين يدرسون درجة كاملة في جامعات كازاخستان. تُتاح بضعة مقاعد سنويًا في البكالوريوس والماجستير والدكتوراه.

about.en:
Based on the February 2025 agreement between Georgia's Ministry of Education, Science and Youth and Kazakhstan's Ministry of Science and Higher Education, this programme lets Georgian citizens study a complete degree in Kazakhstan with tuition and living costs paid. IEC runs the national competition and nominates candidates.

In the 2025-26 round there were 2 bachelor's places, 2 master's places and 1 PhD place, at universities listed in an annex to the call. Teaching is in Kazakh, Russian or English depending on the programme.

With very few places and a small applicant pool, a well-prepared application has a realistic chance.

en: Tuition and living costs funded by Kazakhstan
Bachelor's, master's and PhD places
Small Georgia-only competition run by IEC

eligibility.en: Citizens of Georgia (or holders of Georgian status-neutral documents) with the previous level of education completed (school certificate for bachelor's, bachelor's for master's, master's for PhD).

en: Look for the call on iec.gov.ge in spring 2027.
Fill in the application form for Kazakh universities (annex to the call) and choose from the listed universities.
Prepare passport copy, notarised English translations of diploma/transcript, motivation and recommendation letters (Kazakh or English), medical/HIV certificate and police clearance.
E-mail the full package to info-iec@iec.gov.ge before the deadline; fix any technical errors within the correction window.
Attend an IEC group meeting/interview if invited.

costs.en: Tuition plus a living allowance paid under the bilateral agreement; check the call for current amounts.

score_reason: Funded degree with very few competitors, but limited places and estimated date

name.ka: სომხეთის რესპუბლიკის სასტიპენდიო პროგრამა (მაგისტრატურა) საქართველოს მოქალაქეებისთვის 2027–28
name.ar: منحة أرمينيا للماجستير لمواطني جورجيا 2027–2028 (عبر مركز التعليم الدولي)

deadline_note: Estimated from the 2025-26 round (applications 17 April – 19 May 2025). Next call expected on iec.gov.ge in spring 2027.

summary.en: A bilateral exchange scholarship that funds Georgian citizens to complete a master's degree in any field at partner universities in Armenia. Applications go through Georgia's International Education Center.
summary.ka: ორმხრივი გაცვლითი სტიპენდია, რომელიც აფინანსებს საქართველოს მოქალაქეების სამაგისტრო სწავლას ნებისმიერი მიმართულებით სომხეთის პარტნიორ უნივერსიტეტებში. განაცხადი შეაქვთ განათლების საერთაშორისო ცენტრში.
summary.ar: منحة تبادل ثنائية تموّل دراسة الماجستير لمواطني جورجيا في أي تخصص بالجامعات الشريكة في أرمينيا، ويُقدَّم الطلب عبر مركز التعليم الدولي في جورجيا.

about.en:
Under the March 2023 memorandum between the education ministries of Georgia and Armenia, Armenia funds master's study for Georgian citizens at partner universities, in any academic field. Georgia's International Education Center collects applications and nominates candidates.

The programme is useful for students who want an affordable regional master's degree close to home, with study possible in Armenian, Russian or English depending on the university.

en: Master's in any field at Armenian partner universities
Funding agreed government-to-government
Short e-mail application through IEC

eligibility.en: Citizens of Georgia (or holders of Georgian status-neutral documents) holding a bachelor's degree.

en: Check iec.gov.ge in April 2027 for the new call.
Choose a programme at one of the partner universities listed in the call.
Prepare CV, motivation letter, diploma and transcript, recommendation and passport copy.
Send the application to info-iec@iec.gov.ge before the deadline.

costs.en: Tuition waiver and support under the bilateral memorandum; see the call for stipend and housing terms.

score_reason: Funded master's nearby; estimated date, limited info on stipend

name.en: IEC Academic Programmes in Italy 2027–28 (Master's & PhD Grant for Georgians)
name.ka: აკადემიური პროგრამები იტალიაში 2027–28 (IEC-ის საგრანტო პროგრამა)
name.ar: البرامج الأكاديمية في إيطاليا 2027–2028 (منحة ماجستير ودكتوراه للجورجيين)

deadline_note: Estimated from the 2025-26 round (applications 8 May – 6 June 2025). Next call expected on iec.gov.ge in May 2027.

summary.en: A Georgian state grant, run with the Italian rectors' conference CRUI, that funds Georgian citizens for master's study in priority fields and PhD study in any field at Italian universities.
summary.ka: სახელმწიფო საგრანტო პროგრამა, რომელსაც IEC იტალიის რექტორთა კონფერენციასთან (CRUI) ერთად ახორციელებს და რომელიც აფინანსებს საქართველოს მოქალაქეების სწავლას იტალიის უნივერსიტეტებში პრიორიტეტული მიმართულებების მაგისტრატურასა და ნებისმიერი მიმართულების დოქტორანტურაში.
summary.ar: منحة حكومية جورجية تُنفَّذ بالشراكة مع مؤتمر رؤساء الجامعات الإيطالية (CRUI)، تموّل دراسة الماجستير في المجالات ذات الأولوية والدكتوراه في أي مجال بالجامعات الإيطالية.

about.en:
Based on a memorandum between IEC and the Conference of Italian University Rectors (CRUI), this partner programme aims to give Georgian students access to Italian master's and doctoral programmes and bring the skills back to Georgia's economy.

Master's funding is limited to priority fields announced each year (in 2025-26 these included areas linked to Georgia's labour-market needs); PhD funding is open to any field. Applicants must already be admitted to, or applying to, an eligible Italian programme. Art applicants submit a portfolio.

Italian public universities have low tuition, so the IEC grant goes a long way towards covering a full degree.

en: Funds Italian master's (priority fields) and PhD (any field)
Backed by CRUI, the Italian rectors' conference
Can be combined with Italy's low public-university fees

eligibility.en: Citizens of Georgia (or holders of Georgian status-neutral documents) admitted to an eligible Italian master's or PhD programme; graduates must commit to the programme's return/work conditions in Georgia.

en: Pick an Italian master's in a priority field (list published with the call) or any PhD.
Register on app.iec.gov.ge when the call opens (May).
Upload CV, motivation letter, diploma, admission/application proof and portfolio (art fields).
Pass the IEC technical check and evaluation; sign the grant contract if selected.

costs.en: IEC funds tuition and/or living costs up to the ceilings in the call (paid in GEL/EUR); exact amounts are set each year.

score_reason: State-backed route to Italian degrees; estimated date

name.en: Czech Bilateral Scholarship for Georgian Students 2027–28 (study & research stays)
name.ka: სასტიპენდიო პროგრამა ჩეხეთში 2027–28 (სასწავლო და კვლევითი ვიზიტები)
name.ar: المنحة الثنائية التشيكية للطلاب الجورجيين 2027–2028 (إقامات دراسية وبحثية)

duration.en: Study stay of 1–10 months (one semester to one academic year)
duration.ka: 1–10 თვიანი სასწავლო ვიზიტი (სემესტრი ან სასწავლო წელი)
duration.ar: إقامة دراسية من شهر إلى عشرة أشهر (فصل أو عام دراسي)

deadline_note: Estimated from the 2025-26 round (applications 20 Feb – 12 Mar 2025). Next call expected on iec.gov.ge in February 2027.

summary.en: A bilateral scholarship for students of Georgian universities to spend a semester or year at a Czech university, with a monthly Czech government stipend and dormitory access. Bachelor's, master's and PhD students in any field can apply.
summary.ka: ორმხრივი სტიპენდია საქართველოს უნივერსიტეტების სტუდენტებისთვის, რომ ჩეხეთის უნივერსიტეტში გაატარონ სემესტრი ან სასწავლო წელი ყოველთვიური სტიპენდიითა და საერთო საცხოვრებლით. მიიღება ბაკალავრიატის, მაგისტრატურისა და დოქტორანტურის სტუდენტები.
summary.ar: منحة ثنائية لطلاب الجامعات الجورجية لقضاء فصل أو عام دراسي في جامعة تشيكية، مع راتب شهري من الحكومة التشيكية وإمكانية السكن الجامعي. يمكن لطلاب البكالوريوس والماجستير والدكتوراه التقدّم.

about.en:
Under the 2017 education agreement between Georgia and the Czech Republic, the Czech Ministry of Education offers short and medium-length study stays to students of Georgian higher education institutions, plus research stays for lecturers and researchers. IEC collects and pre-selects applications.

This is not a full-degree scholarship: students stay enrolled at their Georgian university and spend up to one academic year in Czechia, so no entrance exams are needed. Many fields require Czech at B2, but English-taught courses are accepted where the host university agrees.

It is a low-competition alternative to Erasmus+ for students whose university has no exchange agreement with a Czech partner.

en: Monthly Czech government stipend and dormitory place on request
Open to bachelor's, master's and PhD students in all fields
No entrance exams: you remain enrolled at your Georgian university

eligibility.en: Active students of Georgian higher education institutions (bachelor's, master's or PhD) who are citizens of Georgia. Czech B2 for many programmes, or English proof (TOEFL/IELTS/CPE) accepted by the host. Invitation/acceptance letter from the Czech host institution.

en: Contact a Czech university and obtain an invitation/acceptance letter.
Prepare CV, motivation letter, diploma/transcript, one recommendation from your Georgian university (issued in the last 6 months), language certificate and passport copy.
PhD applicants add a research plan (max. 3 pages) and publication list.
E-mail the package to info-iec@iec.gov.ge during the February–March window.

costs.en: Monthly stipend paid by the Czech Ministry of Education (researchers: CZK 933/day); host dormitory at student rates. Travel to and from Czechia is paid by the student.

score_reason: Easy, funded semester in Central Europe; not a full degree

name.en: Visegrad Scholarship Program 2027 (Master's & Post-Master's)
name.ka: ვიშეგრადის სასტიპენდიო პროგრამა 2027 (მაგისტრატურა და შემდგომი საფეხური)
name.ar: برنامج منح فيشغراد 2027 (ماجستير وما بعده)

country.ar: التشيك أو المجر أو بولندا أو سلوفاكيا

deadline_note: Confirmed on the Fund's apply page: call opens 1 Jan 2027, final deadline 15 Apr 2027 (12:00 CET), results 31 May 2027.

summary.en: The Visegrad Fund pays €3,500 per semester to master's and post-master's students from Georgia and other Eastern Partnership and Western Balkan countries to study or research for one or two semesters in Czechia, Hungary, Poland or Slovakia.
summary.ka: ვიშეგრადის ფონდი სემესტრში €3,500-ს უხდის საქართველოსა და აღმოსავლეთ პარტნიორობისა და დასავლეთ ბალკანეთის ქვეყნების მაგისტრანტებსა და დოქტორანტებს ჩეხეთში, უნგრეთში, პოლონეთში ან სლოვაკეთში ერთი ან ორი სემესტრით სწავლისა თუ კვლევისთვის.
summary.ar: يدفع صندوق فيشغراد 3,500 يورو لكل فصل لطلاب الماجستير وما بعده من جورجيا ودول الشراكة الشرقية وغرب البلقان للدراسة أو البحث فصلًا أو فصلين في التشيك أو المجر أو بولندا أو سلوفاكيا.

about.en:
The International Visegrad Fund (Czechia, Hungary, Poland, Slovakia) funds 1–2 semesters of master's study or post-master's (doctoral/postdoc) research at more than 190 accredited universities and research institutes in the V4 countries, in any discipline and any language.

Citizens of Albania, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Kosovo, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia and Ukraine can apply to study in a V4 country; V4 citizens can also apply to go to another V4 country or to these partner countries. Applicants must hold at least a bachelor's degree.

The grant is generous for the region: €3,500 per semester to the scholar plus €2,000 per semester to the host institution, which makes host universities keen to accept Visegrad scholars.

en: €3,500 per semester for the student + €2,000 to the host
Any field, any language, 190+ host institutions
Clear published timeline: deadline 15 April 2027

eligibility.en: Holders of a bachelor's or master's degree who are citizens/residents of a V4 country or of Albania, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Kosovo, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia or Ukraine; the host country must differ from your country of citizenship/residence.

en: Find a host university or institute in Czechia, Hungary, Poland or Slovakia (see the Fund's instructions).
Get a letter of acceptance, or proof that you have applied.
Prepare transcripts for at least the last two semesters (or diploma supplement); post-master's applicants add a research plan.
Submit online via the Fund's application system between 1 Jan and 15 Apr 2027 (12:00 CET).

costs.en: €3,500 per semester paid to the scholar and €2,000 per semester to the host institution (which normally waives tuition). No separate travel allowance.

score_reason: Confirmed dates, generous stipend, Georgians explicitly eligible

name.en: Lithuanian State Scholarships for Full-Time Master's Studies 2027
name.ka: ლიტვის სახელმწიფო სტიპენდიები სრული სამაგისტრო სწავლისთვის 2027
name.ar: المنح الحكومية الليتوانية لدراسة الماجستير بدوام كامل 2027

deadline_note: Estimated from the 2026 call (deadline 20 April 2026, now closed). The 2027 call is expected on studyin.lt in early 2027.

summary.en: Lithuania's government pays tuition and a monthly stipend of about €590 for citizens of Georgia and 15 other countries doing a full master's degree at a Lithuanian university.
summary.ka: ლიტვის მთავრობა უფარავს სწავლის საფასურს და იხდის თვეში დაახლოებით €590 სტიპენდიას საქართველოსა და კიდევ 15 ქვეყნის მოქალაქეებს, რომლებიც ლიტვის უნივერსიტეტში სრულ მაგისტრატურას გადიან.
summary.ar: تدفع حكومة ليتوانيا الرسوم الدراسية وراتبًا شهريًا يقارب 590 يورو لمواطني جورجيا و15 دولة أخرى يدرسون الماجستير كاملًا في جامعة ليتوانية.

about.en:
Every year the Education Exchanges Support Foundation opens a call for Lithuanian state scholarships for full-time master's degrees (or the last two years of integrated studies) at Lithuanian higher education institutions.

The 2026 call was open to citizens of Armenia, Azerbaijan, China (incl. Taiwan), Georgia, Indonesia, Israel, Japan, Kazakhstan, Moldova, New Zealand, the Philippines, South Korea, Ukraine, the USA, Uzbekistan, Vietnam and foreign citizens of Lithuanian origin. Applicants need a bachelor's degree by the start of studies and an acceptance or pre-acceptance letter.

The award covers tuition up to the national standard study cost and pays 8 Basic Social Amounts per month (€592 in 2026), enough to live on in Vilnius or Kaunas.

en: Tuition plus ~€590/month stipend
Georgians explicitly eligible
Wide choice of English-taught master's programmes

eligibility.en: Citizens of Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, China, Indonesia, Israel, Japan, Kazakhstan, Moldova, New Zealand, Philippines, South Korea, Ukraine, USA, Uzbekistan, Vietnam, or foreign citizens of Lithuanian origin, holding a bachelor's degree by the start of studies, with acceptance/pre-acceptance from a Lithuanian HEI.

en: Apply to an English-taught master's programme at a Lithuanian university (most deadlines spring).
Obtain an acceptance or pre-acceptance letter.
When the 2027 call opens on studyin.lt, submit the scholarship application online with the letter, CV, transcript and motivation.
Wait for the Foundation's decision (usually summer).

about.en:
Every school leaver who sits the Unified National Exams (UNE) in Georgia competes automatically for a state study grant. Grants are awarded on exam results and cover 50%, 70% or 100% of the standard annual state tuition of GEL 2,250 (for example, a 100% grant fully covers bachelor's tuition at Tbilisi State University). The grant follows the student to any accredited university, public or private; at private universities it is credited against the higher fee.

Registration takes place online with NAEC in spring, the exams are held in July, and grants are announced with the results in August. Many universities stack their own internal grants on top of the state grant for top scorers.

For Georgian students this is the single most important scholarship decision: good UNE preparation can make the whole degree free.

en: Up to 100% of GEL 2,250 annual tuition
Usable at any accredited Georgian university
Awarded automatically from UNE results; no separate application

eligibility.en: Graduates of general education (12th grade) in Georgia, or holders of an equivalent certificate, registering for the Unified National Exams. Georgian citizens and eligible residents; foreign nationals usually enter universities without UNE and are not eligible for the state grant.

en: Register for the Unified National Exams on online.naec.ge during the spring registration window.
Choose the subjects required by your target programmes; sit the exams in July.
Rank your university/programme choices in the NAEC system.
Grant results are published with admission results; the grant is credited to your university each year you remain enrolled.

costs.en: State grant of 50%, 70% or 100% of GEL 2,250 per year. Any difference to a higher private-university fee is paid by the student or by internal grants.

name.ar: منحة PMCG القائمة على الحاجة في ISET — ماجستير الاقتصاد 2027

deadline_note: Estimated: ISET says the call is announced periodically, typically in spring. Check iset.ge in spring 2027.

summary.en: The consulting firm PMCG funds a need-based scholarship for students of ISET's English-taught MA in Economics in Tbilisi, so that talented students can study regardless of their finances.
summary.ka: საკონსულტაციო კომპანია PMCG აფინანსებს საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებულ სტიპენდიას ISET-ის ინგლისურენოვანი ეკონომიკის მაგისტრატურის სტუდენტებისთვის, რათა ნიჭიერმა სტუდენტებმა ფინანსური მდგომარეობის მიუხედავად ისწავლონ.
summary.ar: تموّل شركة الاستشارات PMCG منحة قائمة على الحاجة لطلاب ماجستير الاقتصاد الذي تدرّسه ISET بالإنجليزية في تبليسي، ليتمكن الطلاب الموهوبون من الدراسة بغض النظر عن أوضاعهم المالية.

about.en:
ISET, the International School of Economics at Tbilisi State University, runs the South Caucasus's leading English-taught MA in Economics. The Policy and Management Consulting Group (PMCG), an international consulting firm that employs many ISET graduates, has created a need-based scholarship for MA students who require financial support to continue their studies.

The award is based on financial need rather than academic ranking. ISET also offers CFA Institute student scholarships and a Bank of Georgia partnership for its Master in Finance.

en: Need-based support for an English-taught MA in Economics
Funded by an employer of ISET graduates
Strong placement into policy, banking and research jobs

eligibility.en: Students admitted to (or enrolled in) ISET's MA in Economics who can document financial need.

en: Apply for admission to ISET's MA in Economics.
Watch iset.ge for the PMCG scholarship call (usually spring).
Submit the scholarship application with evidence of financial need.
Contact ISET admissions for questions.

costs.en: Partial or full tuition support depending on need and the call terms.

score_reason: Niche but useful need-based aid; date estimated

name.en: Qatar University STEM Sponsorship Program 2027–28
name.ka: კატარის უნივერსიტეტის STEM სპონსორობის პროგრამა 2027–28
name.ar: برنامج رعاية العلوم (STEM) في جامعة قطر 2027–2028

deadline_note: Rolling within the year: students apply through the QU sponsorship system during the academic year in which they are admitted to the STEM major.

summary.en: Qatar University pays Qatari students a monthly salary of QR 3,000 and covers textbooks if they major in priority STEM fields such as computer science, mathematics, chemistry, statistics, nursing or civil engineering.
summary.ka: კატარის უნივერსიტეტი კატარელ სტუდენტებს თვეში 3 000 რიალს უხდის და სახელმძღვანელოების საფასურსაც ფარავს, თუ ისინი პრიორიტეტულ STEM მიმართულებებს აირჩევენ: კომპიუტერული მეცნიერება, მათემატიკა, ქიმია, სტატისტიკა, ექთნობა ან სამოქალაქო ინჟინერია.
summary.ar: تمنح جامعة قطر الطلبة القطريين راتبًا شهريًا قدره 3,000 ريال وتعفيهم من رسوم الكتب إذا تخصصوا في مجالات STEM ذات الأولوية مثل علوم الحاسب والرياضيات والكيمياء والإحصاء والتمريض والهندسة المدنية.

about.en:
The STEM Sponsorship Program was created to attract Qatari students into science, technology, engineering and mathematics majors in line with Qatar National Vision 2030. Seats per field are set every year according to national needs.

Covered majors (2026 list): for men, chemistry, mathematics, civil engineering, computer science, environmental sciences, statistics, nursing and biomedical sciences; for women, chemistry, mathematics, physics, computer science, physical therapy, statistics, nursing, biomedical sciences and biology. Medicine and dental medicine are excluded.

Sponsored students must keep a GPA of at least 2.5, pass 12+ credit hours per semester and register continuously until graduation.

en: QR 3,000 monthly salary plus free textbooks
Open to Qataris and children/husbands of Qataris and Qatari travel-document holders
No documents needed: apply online after declaring your major

eligibility.en: Qatari nationals, husbands and children of Qatari women, and holders of Qatari travel documents, with a high-school average of at least 75%, accepted into a covered STEM major at QU, not holding another sponsorship or scholarship.

en: Apply for admission to Qatar University.
Declare a major on the STEM sponsorship list.
Log in to the QU sponsorship application system and follow the user guide (no documents required).
Keep GPA ≥ 2.5 and 12+ credits per semester to retain the sponsorship.

costs.en: QR 3,000 per month plus exemption from textbook fees (tuition is already free for Qatari students at QU).

score_reason: Monthly salary for Qatari STEM students, easy online application

name.en: Qatar University Talent Sponsorship Program 2027–28
name.ka: კატარის უნივერსიტეტის ნიჭის სპონსორობის პროგრამა 2027–28
name.ar: برنامج رعاية الموهوبين في جامعة قطر 2027–2028

deadline_note: Applied for through the 'Scholarship Application' page of QU's online admission application during the announced Fall 2027 admission period; exact dates published by QU.

summary.en: Qatar University sponsors Qatari school leavers with outstanding talent in scientific research, technology and innovation, literature, acting, media or sport. Applicants submit a talent portfolio, two recommendation letters and pass an interview.
summary.ka: კატარის უნივერსიტეტი აფინანსებს კატარელ აბიტურიენტებს, რომლებსაც განსაკუთრებული ნიჭი აქვთ სამეცნიერო კვლევაში, ტექნოლოგიებსა და ინოვაციაში, ლიტერატურაში, სამსახიობო ხელოვნებაში, მედიაში ან სპორტში. საჭიროა პორტფოლიო, ორი სარეკომენდაციო წერილი და გასაუბრება.
summary.ar: ترعى جامعة قطر خريجي الثانوية القطريين أصحاب المواهب المتميزة في البحث العلمي أو التكنولوجيا والابتكار أو الأدب أو التمثيل أو الإعلام أو الرياضة، ويقدّم المتقدم ملف إنجازات وخطابَي توصية ويجتاز مقابلة.

about.en:
The Talent Sponsorship rewards Qatari students who have proven achievements in one of QU's talent fields: scientific research (including arts and sciences), technology and innovation, literature, acting (male), media and athletics. Applications are made with the online admission application.

Applicants need at least 75% in the first semester of grade 12, two letters from recognised entities in their field, a statement of talent and achievements with links to videos or portfolios, and a successful interview (athletes also pass a physical fitness exam). A conditional acceptance is sent within six weeks of the sponsorship deadline.

Sponsored students must keep a GPA of 2.3, take 12+ credits a semester and represent QU in their talent field locally and internationally.

en: Sponsorship for talent in research, tech, literature, media, acting or sport
Portfolio + interview selection
Represent QU nationally and internationally

eligibility.en: Qatari nationals (and eligible children/husbands of Qataris, Qatari travel-document holders) with at least 75% in grade 12 first semester and proven recent achievements in one talent field. Cannot be combined with another sponsorship.

en: Apply online to Qatar University for Fall 2027 entry.
On the 'Scholarship Application' page, choose the Talent Sponsorship and upload two recommendation letters.
Upload a talent statement with links to videos/portfolio (Dropbox/OneDrive) showing recent achievements.
Attend the interview (and fitness test for sport).
Receive conditional acceptance within ~6 weeks; submit final documents.

costs.en: Sponsorship benefits per QU's monthly salary scale for sponsorship programmes (monthly allowance; tuition is free for Qataris at QU).

score_reason: Unusual talent-based route for Qatari students

org: Education Above All Foundation (Al Fakhoora) & University of Doha for Science and Technology

name.en: Dynamic Futures Qatar (DFQ) Scholarship at UDST — Education Above All 2027
name.ka: Dynamic Futures Qatar (DFQ) სტიპენდია UDST-ში — Education Above All 2027
name.ar: منحة «مستقبل ديناميكي قطر» في جامعة الدوحة للعلوم والتكنولوجيا — مؤسسة التعليم فوق الجميع 2027

deadline_note: Applications are announced by UDST's Admission and Registration Department during the Fall semester for students enrolled that Fall; check UDST announcements (Fall 2027 for new entrants).

summary.en: Education Above All's Al Fakhoora programme funds expatriate young people who have grown up in Qatar to study a bachelor's degree at UDST. It targets residents with financial need who have studied in Qatar for at least eight years.
summary.ka: Education Above All-ის პროგრამა Al Fakhoora აფინანსებს კატარში გაზრდილ უცხოელ ახალგაზრდებს UDST-ში საბაკალავრო სწავლისთვის. იგი განკუთვნილია ფინანსური საჭიროების მქონე რეზიდენტებისთვის, რომლებმაც კატარში მინიმუმ რვა წელი ისწავლეს.
summary.ar: يموّل برنامج الفاخورة التابع لمؤسسة التعليم فوق الجميع الشباب المقيمين الذين نشأوا في قطر لدراسة البكالوريوس في جامعة الدوحة للعلوم والتكنولوجيا، ويستهدف المقيمين ذوي الحاجة المالية الذين درسوا في قطر ثماني سنوات على الأقل.

about.en:
Dynamic Futures Qatar (DFQ) is a scholarship from the Education Above All (EAA) Foundation, through its Al Fakhoora programme, for expatriate youth living in Qatar who are about to start or are early in their studies at UDST. It prioritises degrees aligned with Qatar's future labour-market needs; orphans and applicants with special needs receive additional consideration.

Selection combines a financial analysis of household income and expenses with EAA student assessments. Only first- and second-year students qualify, and Foundation Program students are excluded.

en: Need-based funding for long-term expatriate residents of Qatar
Run by Education Above All's Al Fakhoora programme
Extra consideration for orphans and students with special needs

eligibility.en: Legal residents of Qatar (valid residency permit) aged 16–27 who have studied in Qatar for at least 8 years, with a minimum 85% high-school average (new Fall entrants) or GPA 3.0 (continuing students), enrolled in the Fall semester in an eligible programme, not receiving other education support, and with family income under the EAA threshold (QAR 12,000 family cap on the scorecard). International (non-resident) students are not eligible.

en: Apply for admission to UDST for Fall 2027.
Watch for the DFQ announcement from UDST's Admission and Registration Department in the Fall semester.
Apply directly to UDST and submit household income and expense documents from the checklist.
Complete EAA's selection assessments; successful applicants are contacted by UDST.

costs.en: Scholarship support for tuition and study costs per EAA's award terms.

score_reason: Rare full-support option for non-Qatari residents of Qatar

org: Jassim and Hamad Bin Jassim Charitable Foundation & UDST

name.en: Jassim and Hamad Bin Jassim Foundation Financial Aid at UDST (Qatari & non-Qatari students)
name.ka: ჯასიმ და ჰამად ბინ ჯასიმის ფონდის ფინანსური დახმარება UDST-ში (კატარელი და არაკატარელი სტუდენტები)
name.ar: مساعدات مؤسسة جاسم وحمد بن جاسم الخيرية في جامعة الدوحة للعلوم والتكنولوجيا (للقطريين وغير القطريين)

duration.en: Per semester, renewable to the end of the study plan
duration.ar: لكل فصل، قابلة للتجديد حتى نهاية الخطة الدراسية

deadline_note: Rolling: applications each semester via UDST Student Self Service before the semester deadline announced by UDST.

summary.en: A charitable foundation pays up to QAR 10,000 a semester in tuition for non-Qatari UDST students in financial need, and QAR 5,000 a semester as an excellence reward to high-achieving Qatari students with limited family income.
summary.ka: საქველმოქმედო ფონდი ფინანსური საჭიროების მქონე არაკატარელ UDST-ის სტუდენტებს სემესტრში 10 000 რიალამდე სწავლის საფასურს უფარავს, ხოლო შეზღუდული შემოსავლის მქონე წარჩინებულ კატარელ სტუდენტებს სემესტრში 5 000 რიალის ჯილდოს აძლევს.
summary.ar: تدفع مؤسسة خيرية حتى 10,000 ريال للفصل من رسوم طلاب الجامعة غير القطريين المحتاجين، و5,000 ريال للفصل مكافأةً للطلبة القطريين المتفوقين محدودي الدخل.

about.en:
The Jassim and Hamad Bin Jassim Charitable Foundation funds two programmes for UDST bachelor's students. The Non-Qatari Student Support Program covers tuition fees only, up to QAR 10,000 per semester, for students with a cumulative GPA of 3.0+ and per-capita family income under QR 1,000 (after loans and rent). The Rewards Program pays QR 5,000 per semester to Qatari students with GPA 3.5+ and per-capita family income under QR 6,000.

Aid can be received for multiple semesters within the study plan, once per academic year. Applications are made through UDST Student Self Service with salary certificates, bank statements and a credit bureau report.

en: Up to QAR 10,000/semester tuition aid for non-Qatari students
QR 5,000/semester rewards for high-achieving Qatari students
Renewable through the study plan

eligibility.en: Actively enrolled UDST bachelor's students. Non-Qatari: GPA ≥ 3.0 and per-capita family income ≤ QR 1,000. Qatari Rewards: GPA ≥ 3.5 and per-capita family income ≤ QR 6,000.

en: Enrol at UDST.
Gather consent form, IDs, guardian's salary certificate, 6 months of bank statements, Qatar Credit Bureau report, debt certificate, employment/rental contracts.
Submit the financial aid application in Student Self Service before the semester deadline.
Respond to any Foundation verification requests.

costs.en: Non-Qatari: tuition up to QAR 10,000 per semester (not summer). Qatari: QR 5,000 per semester.

score_reason: Open to non-Qatari residents in need; partial

org: University of Doha for Science and Technology (UDST)

name.en: UDST Varsity Sports Scholarship 2027–28
name.ka: UDST-ის სპორტული (Varsity) სტიპენდია 2027–28
name.ar: منحة الرياضة الجامعية في جامعة الدوحة للعلوم والتكنولوجيا 2027–2028

deadline_note: Estimated: apply with Fall 2027 admission (UDST undergraduate early-acceptance deadlines 31 Jan / 28 Feb 2027; final dates follow your offer). Confirm with UDST Sport.

summary.en: UDST offers student-athletes in selected team sports full tuition exemption, a monthly allowance, priority registration and academic and athletic support.
summary.ka: UDST შერჩეულ გუნდურ სპორტში ნიჭიერ სპორტსმენ სტუდენტებს სთავაზობს სწავლის საფასურისგან სრულ გათავისუფლებას, ყოველთვიურ დახმარებას, პრიორიტეტულ რეგისტრაციასა და აკადემიურ და სპორტულ მხარდაჭერას.
summary.ar: تقدّم جامعة الدوحة للعلوم والتكنولوجيا للطلاب الرياضيين في رياضات مختارة إعفاءً كاملًا من الرسوم وبدلًا شهريًا وأولوية في التسجيل ودعمًا أكاديميًا ورياضيًا.

about.en:
The UDST Varsity Sports Scholarship supports dedicated athletes who show exceptional talent in one of the sports listed by the university (individual sports outside the list are not currently considered). Winners receive full tuition exemption, a monthly allowance, priority registration and dedicated academic and athletic support while playing for UDST's varsity teams.

Selection looks at sporting excellence and a minimum C+ (78% or GPA 2.0) high-school record, a sports CV, video footage, coach letters, a statement, medical records, international clearances where needed, and a final interview.

en: Full tuition exemption + monthly allowance
For athletes in UDST's listed varsity sports
Applied university in Doha with industry links

eligibility.en: Applicants admitted to UDST with proven excellence in a listed sport and at least C+ (78%/2.0 GPA) in high school. Check UDST for nationality rules.

en: Apply for UDST admission for Fall 2027.
Prepare a sports CV, video footage, coach letters, statement and medical records.
Submit the varsity scholarship application to UDST Sport and Varsity.
Attend the final interview.

costs.en: Full tuition exemption plus a monthly allowance.

score_reason: Full tuition for athletes; limited sports list

org: University of Doha for Science and Technology (UDST)

name.en: UDST Graduate Sponsorship Research Award (GSRA) 2027
name.ka: UDST-ის სამაგისტრო და სადოქტორო კვლევითი სპონსორობა (GSRA) 2027
name.ar: جائزة رعاية البحث للدراسات العليا (GSRA) في جامعة الدوحة للعلوم والتكنولوجيا 2027

duration.en: Master's up to 2 years; PhD up to 4 years
duration.ar: ماجستير حتى سنتين؛ دكتوراه حتى أربع سنوات

deadline_note: Estimated from the last published cycle (deadline 21 April, noon Doha time). Confirm the 2027 date with UDST Applied Research and Graduate Studies.

summary.en: UDST's GSRA turns a bachelor's capstone project into a funded master's or PhD at UDST, covering full tuition and conference travel; international awardees also get health insurance, a settlement allowance and an annual air ticket.
summary.ka: UDST-ის GSRA ბაკალავრის დიპლომის პროექტს UDST-ში დაფინანსებულ მაგისტრატურად ან დოქტორანტურად აქცევს: ფარავს სწავლის საფასურს და კონფერენციის ხარჯებს, ხოლო უცხოელ სტიპენდიანტებს დამატებით აძლევს დაზღვევას, დასახლების დახმარებასა და წლიურ ავიაბილეთს.
summary.ar: تحوّل جائزة GSRA مشروع التخرج في البكالوريوس إلى ماجستير أو دكتوراه ممولة في الجامعة، وتغطي الرسوم كاملة وبدل المؤتمرات، ويحصل الفائزون الدوليون أيضًا على تأمين صحي وبدل استقرار وتذكرة طيران سنوية.

about.en:
The Graduate Sponsorship Research Award (GSRA) at the University of Doha for Science and Technology nurtures future faculty and researchers. It has a local track and an international track, and supports students joining UDST's full-time graduate programmes, ideally building on their bachelor's capstone project.

It covers full tuition for up to 2 years (master's) or 4 years (PhD), up to QAR 18,000 per year for conferences and, for international awardees, health insurance, a settlement allowance and an annual air ticket.

en: Full tuition for master's (2 yrs) or PhD (4 yrs)
Up to QAR 18,000/year conference allowance
International track with insurance, settlement allowance and flights

eligibility.en: Applicants under 40 at the deadline who are accepted into, or applying for, a full-time UDST graduate programme starting the next academic year. Local and international tracks.

en: Choose a UDST master's or PhD programme and identify a research supervisor.
Prepare a proposal building on your capstone/research project.
Submit the GSRA application before the April deadline (research office vetting follows a week later).
Contact UDST Applied Research and Graduate Studies for the current call.

costs.en: Full tuition; conference allowance up to QAR 18,000/year; health insurance, settlement allowance and annual air ticket for international awardees.

score_reason: Funded graduate study in Doha incl. international track; date estimated

org: Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation of Oman (MoHERI)

name.en: Omani Programme for Cultural and Scientific Cooperation — Scholarships for International Students
name.ka: ომანის კულტურული და სამეცნიერო თანამშრომლობის პროგრამა — სტიპენდიები უცხოელი სტუდენტებისთვის
name.ar: البرنامج العُماني للتعاون الثقافي والعلمي — منح للطلبة الدوليين

deadline_note: Rolling/annual: seats are offered each year to priority 'friendly and brotherly' countries, usually through their ministries or Omani embassies; contact MoHERI.

summary.en: Oman's Ministry of Higher Education offers undergraduate scholarships at public and private Omani universities to students from friendly and brotherly countries, to strengthen international cooperation and attract international students.
summary.ka: ომანის უმაღლესი განათლების სამინისტრო მეგობარი ქვეყნების სტუდენტებს სთავაზობს საბაკალავრო სტიპენდიებს ომანის სახელმწიფო და კერძო უნივერსიტეტებში, საერთაშორისო თანამშრომლობის გასაღრმავებლად.
summary.ar: تقدّم وزارة التعليم العالي والبحث العلمي والابتكار في سلطنة عُمان منحًا للمرحلة الجامعية الأولى في مؤسسات التعليم العالي الحكومية والخاصة لطلبة الدول الشقيقة والصديقة، تعزيزًا للتعاون الدولي.

about.en:
The Omani Programme for Cultural and Scientific Cooperation with Friendly and Brotherly Countries is managed by MoHERI's Scholarships Section, which also handles scholarships offered to Oman by other countries. Its aim is to build international cooperation and human capacity in priority countries and to attract international students to Oman.

The programme offers a number of scholarships and study missions for first-degree (bachelor's) study at government and private higher education institutions inside Oman. Places are allocated per country, so candidates usually apply through their own education ministry or the Omani embassy.

en: Bachelor's study in Oman for international students
Public and private Omani universities
Government-to-government allocation of seats

eligibility.en: Citizens of countries designated by Oman as priority/friendly countries (check with MoHERI or the Omani embassy); secondary-school graduates meeting university admission rules.

en: Ask your country's education ministry or the Omani embassy whether seats are offered this year.
Contact MoHERI's postgraduate & scholarships department (postgraduate@moheri.gov.om).
Submit the nomination file (certificates, passport, medical) as instructed.
Await placement at an Omani university.

costs.en: Scholarship for undergraduate study in Oman; benefits are set per agreement and institution.

score_reason: Official but thin details; depends on country allocation

name.ar: منحة الحكومة اليابانية (MEXT) للطلاب الجورجيين 2028 — البكالوريوس وكليات التكنولوجيا والتدريب المتخصص (عبر السفارة)

duration.en: 1 year of Japanese language + 4–6 years of degree (undergraduate); 3–5 years (KOSEN/specialized)
duration.ka: 1 წელი იაპონური ენა + 4–6 წელი ბაკალავრიატი; 3–5 წელი (KOSEN/სპეციალიზებული)
duration.ar: سنة لغة يابانية + 4–6 سنوات بكالوريوس؛ 3–5 سنوات (KOSEN/تدريب متخصص)

deadline_note: Estimated: the Embassy's call for the 2027 programme was published 27 April 2026 with a 5 June 2026 deadline. The 2028 call is expected around April–June 2027.

summary.en: Japan's MEXT scholarship pays full tuition, a monthly stipend and return airfare for Georgian school leavers to study a bachelor's degree, a technical college (KOSEN) course or a specialized training college course in Japan. Georgian applicants apply through the Embassy of Japan in Tbilisi and sit written exams and an interview.
summary.ka: იაპონიის მთავრობის MEXT სტიპენდია ფარავს სწავლის საფასურს, ყოველთვიურ სტიპენდიასა და ავიაბილეთებს საქართველოს აბიტურიენტებისთვის, რომლებიც იაპონიაში ბაკალავრიატზე, ტექნოლოგიურ კოლეჯში (KOSEN) ან სპეციალიზებულ კოლეჯში ისწავლიან. განაცხადი შეაქვთ თბილისში იაპონიის საელჩოში, რასაც მოჰყვება წერითი გამოცდა და გასაუბრება.
summary.ar: تغطي منحة الحكومة اليابانية MEXT الرسوم الدراسية وراتبًا شهريًا وتذاكر الطيران لخريجي الثانوية الجورجيين لدراسة البكالوريوس أو كليات التكنولوجيا (KOSEN) أو كليات التدريب المتخصص في اليابان، ويُقدَّم الطلب عبر سفارة اليابان في تبليسي مع امتحان كتابي ومقابلة.

about.en:
Every year the Embassy of Japan in Georgia recommends Georgian candidates to Japan's Ministry of Education (MEXT) for the Japanese Government Scholarship. The embassy round covers Undergraduate Students, College of Technology (KOSEN) Students, Specialized Training College Students and Research Students (research students are listed separately on Meridian).

For the 2027 programme, applicants had to submit originals to the Embassy and a digital copy to culture@tb.mofa.go.jp by 5 June 2026; written exams followed in late June and interviews in early July, before final selection by MEXT. Guidelines and exam subjects are published on Study in Japan.

MEXT is one of the most generous undergraduate scholarships in the world: it includes a preparatory year of Japanese and covers the whole degree.

en: Full tuition, ~JPY 117,000 monthly stipend and return airfare
Includes a preparatory year of Japanese language
Georgia-only embassy round with exams in Tbilisi

eligibility.en: Georgian citizens meeting MEXT age limits (for undergraduates typically aged 17–24 at the start of the programme) who have completed or will complete 12 years of schooling; willingness to learn Japanese; good health. See each category's guideline on Study in Japan.

en: Read the 2028 guideline for your category on studyinjapan.go.jp when the Embassy publishes the call (spring 2027).
Prepare the application form, placement preference form, transcripts, graduation certificate, recommendation and health certificate.
Submit originals to the Embassy of Japan (Chavchavadze Ave. 64b, Tbilisi) and the digital set to culture@tb.mofa.go.jp by the deadline.
Sit the written exams (late June) and interview (early July).
Wait for MEXT's final decision and university placement.

costs.en: MEXT pays tuition, entrance and exam fees, a monthly allowance (around JPY 117,000 for undergraduates under current rules) and round-trip airfare.

score_reason: World-class fully funded undergraduate route with a Georgia-only round

name.ka: იაპონიის მთავრობის (MEXT) სტიპენდია იაპონისტიკის სტუდენტებისთვის 2027–28
name.ar: منحة MEXT للدراسات اليابانية للطلاب الجورجيين 2027–2028

deadline_note: Estimated: the 2025 round closed 7 February 2025 with exams on 20–21 February; the 2027 call is expected on the Embassy site in January 2027.

summary.en: A one-year MEXT scholarship for Georgian university students majoring in Japanese language or culture to study at a Japanese university, with tuition, a monthly stipend and airfare covered.
summary.ka: MEXT-ის ერთწლიანი სტიპენდია ქართველი სტუდენტებისთვის, რომლებიც იაპონურ ენასა და კულტურას სწავლობენ, იაპონიის უნივერსიტეტში სასწავლებლად; ფარავს სწავლის საფასურს, ყოველთვიურ სტიპენდიასა და ავიაბილეთს.
summary.ar: منحة MEXT لمدة عام للطلاب الجامعيين الجورجيين المتخصصين في اللغة أو الثقافة اليابانية للدراسة في جامعة يابانية، وتغطي الرسوم وراتبًا شهريًا وتذاكر الطيران.

about.en:
The Japanese Studies track of the MEXT scholarship lets undergraduates who major in Japanese language and culture outside Japan spend up to one year at a Japanese university improving their language and studying Japanese affairs. It is not a degree programme: students return to finish their degree at home.

In Georgia the Embassy of Japan runs the first screening (documents, a written test and a face-to-face interview in February) and recommends successful candidates to MEXT, which announces placements in July–August for arrival in September–October.

en: Year in Japan fully funded by MEXT
For Georgian students of Japanese language/culture
First screening in Tbilisi in February

eligibility.en: Georgian citizens enrolled in an undergraduate programme at a university outside Japan, majoring in a field related to Japanese language and culture, within the MEXT age range (for 2025: born 2 April 1995 – 1 April 2007).

en: Watch the Embassy's site in January for the call.
Complete the MEXT Japanese Studies application form and placement preference form (fillable PDFs) and the health certificate.
Submit by e-mail to culture@tb.mofa.go.jp and in person/by post to the Embassy before the deadline.
Take the written exam and interview in February; await MEXT's decision in summer.

costs.en: Tuition waived; monthly MEXT allowance; round-trip airfare.

score_reason: Fully funded year in Japan for a narrow group of students

name.en: IEC State Grant for Doctoral Studies Abroad 2027–28
name.ka: სახელმწიფო საგრანტო პროგრამა „საზღვარგარეთ სადოქტორო საფეხურზე განათლების მიღების ხელშეწყობა“ 2027–28
name.ar: المنحة الحكومية الجورجية لدراسة الدكتوراه في الخارج 2027–2028

deadline_note: Estimated from the 2025-26 round (applications 25 Feb – 15 Apr 2025). Next call expected on iec.gov.ge in February 2027.

summary.en: Georgia's state grant for doctoral study abroad funds Georgian citizens admitted to PhD programmes at leading foreign universities, covering tuition/research costs and living expenses in return for working in Georgia afterwards.
summary.ka: სახელმწიფო საგრანტო პროგრამა აფინანსებს საქართველოს მოქალაქეებს, რომლებიც საზღვარგარეთის წამყვან უნივერსიტეტებში დოქტორანტურაზე ჩაირიცხნენ: ფარავს სწავლის/კვლევის საფასურსა და ცხოვრების ხარჯებს, სანაცვლოდ კი სწავლის შემდეგ საქართველოში მუშაობას ითვალისწინებს.
summary.ar: تموّل المنحة الحكومية الجورجية دراسة الدكتوراه في الخارج لمواطني جورجيا المقبولين في جامعات أجنبية رائدة، وتغطي الرسوم/البحث وتكاليف المعيشة مقابل العمل في جورجيا بعد التخرج.

about.en:
The International Education Center (IEC) runs the state programme 'Support for doctoral-level education abroad' each academic year. Georgian citizens apply in a first stage with their profile and research plan, then submit proof of admission and tuition/research funding needs in a second stage.

The grant cannot be combined with other European or state funding (Erasmus+, Erasmus Mundus etc.) for the same studies. Grant holders must return and work in Georgia after graduation, although they may stay abroad for up to one year after completing their studies under the programme rules.

en: State funding for a full PhD abroad
Two-stage application: profile, then admission documents
Part of Georgia's flagship IEC programmes

eligibility.en: Citizens of Georgia (or holders of Georgian status-neutral documents) with a master's degree, applying to or admitted to a doctoral programme at an eligible foreign university; must accept the return-and-work obligation.

en: Secure (or apply for) admission to a doctoral programme abroad.
Register on app.iec.gov.ge during the February–April window and upload CV, motivation, diplomas and research plan.
In stage II, upload the admission letter and tuition/research cost documents.
Sign the grant contract if selected.

costs.en: Tuition/research fees and living costs up to the ceilings set in the annual call (paid in GEL equivalent).

score_reason: Funds full PhDs abroad for Georgians; date estimated

name.en: IEC State Co-Funding for High-Achieving Stipendium Hungaricum Holders 2027–28
name.ka: IEC-ის სახელმწიფო დაფინანსება „Stipendium Hungaricum“-ის მაღალი აკადემიური მოსწრების მქონე მფლობელებისთვის 2027–28
name.ar: التمويل الحكومي الجورجي الإضافي لحاملي منحة Stipendium Hungaricum المتفوقين 2027–2028

duration.en: Per semester, for the length of the degree

deadline_note: Estimated from the 2025-26 round (applications 15 July – 15 September 2025, reviewed in two batches). A spring-semester round is also run.

summary.en: Georgian students who win a Stipendium Hungaricum place and have high academic results can get an extra €1,250 per semester from Georgia's state budget through IEC, on top of the Hungarian scholarship.
summary.ka: საქართველოს მოქალაქეებს, რომლებმაც „Stipendium Hungaricum“ მოიპოვეს და მაღალი აკადემიური მოსწრება აქვთ, IEC დამატებით სემესტრში €1,250-ს უხდის სახელმწიფო ბიუჯეტიდან, უნგრული სტიპენდიის გარდა.
summary.ar: يمكن للطلاب الجورجيين الحاصلين على منحة Stipendium Hungaricum وذوي النتائج الأكاديمية العالية الحصول على 1,250 يورو إضافية لكل فصل من الميزانية الحكومية الجورجية عبر مركز التعليم الدولي.

about.en:
Stipendium Hungaricum covers tuition and a modest stipend in Hungary. Because living costs exceed the Hungarian stipend, Georgia's International Education Center runs a partner programme that adds state funding for high-achieving Georgian SH holders at bachelor's and master's level.

In 2025-26 the top-up was €1,250 per semester (paid in GEL equivalent). Recipients commit to return to Georgia within one month of graduating and to work there, though graduates may continue to further study abroad in the same field.

en: €1,250 extra per semester on top of Stipendium Hungaricum
For Georgian SH winners with high grades
Autumn and spring application rounds

eligibility.en: Citizens of Georgia holding a Stipendium Hungaricum scholarship with high academic performance (criteria in the call); return-and-work obligation applies.

en: Win a Stipendium Hungaricum place (separate application via the Tempus Public Foundation).
When the IEC co-funding call opens (July), apply on app.iec.gov.ge with your SH award letter and transcripts.
Applications received by mid-August and mid-September are reviewed in batches.
Sign the IEC contract if approved.

costs.en: €1,250 per semester (GEL equivalent), in addition to the Hungarian scholarship.

score_reason: Valuable top-up but only for existing SH winners

org: International Education Center of Georgia (IEC) & French Institute of Georgia / Campus France

name.en: France Excellence Master's Programmes for Georgian Citizens 2027–28 (IEC)
name.ka: სამაგისტრო პროგრამები საფრანგეთში — France Excellence 2027–28 (IEC)
