deadline_note: Estimated from the 2025-26 round (IEC system open 17 Dec 2024 – 31 Jan 2025, 23:59 Tbilisi time). Next call expected on iec.gov.ge in December 2026.

summary.en: A joint Georgian–French scholarship for Georgian citizens up to age 30 to do a master's in France, paying €560 a month towards study costs plus a €300 monthly stipend, with French government benefits such as visa support and tuition exemption at public universities.
summary.ka: ქართულ-ფრანგული სასტიპენდიო პროგრამა 30 წლამდე საქართველოს მოქალაქეებისთვის საფრანგეთში მაგისტრატურისთვის: თვეში €560 სასწავლო გრანტი და €300 სტიპენდია, ასევე საფრანგეთის მთავრობის შეღავათები (ვიზა, საჯარო უნივერსიტეტებში სწავლის საფასურისგან გათავისუფლება).
summary.ar: منحة جورجية-فرنسية مشتركة لمواطني جورجيا حتى سن 30 لدراسة الماجستير في فرنسا، تدفع 560 يورو شهريًا لتكاليف الدراسة و300 يورو راتبًا شهريًا، مع مزايا الحكومة الفرنسية مثل دعم التأشيرة والإعفاء من الرسوم في الجامعات العامة.

about.en:
France Excellence for Georgia is a partner programme between IEC and the French Institute of Georgia (French Embassy), administered with Campus France. It is co-funded by Georgia and by the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs and Ministry of Higher Education.

Winners hold both an IEC grant and French government scholar status: IEC pays a €560 monthly study grant and a €300 monthly stipend, and the French side provides benefits such as visa facilitation, social security and exemption from tuition at public institutions. Applicants handle admission to French universities themselves; priority fields are listed in each call, with some interdisciplinary fields also considered.

en: €860 per month in total (study grant + stipend)
French government scholar status and benefits
For Georgians aged 30 or under

eligibility.en: Citizens of Georgia aged 30 or under, holding (or completing) a bachelor's degree, applying to master's programmes at French higher education institutions in the call's priority fields.

en: Choose a French master's in a priority field and apply for admission (Campus France procedure).
Register on app.iec.gov.ge between mid-December and 31 January and upload CV, motivation, diplomas and language certificates.
Complete the parallel Campus France/French Institute steps described in the call.
Attend interviews; winners sign the IEC contract.

costs.en: IEC: €560/month study grant + €300/month stipend. French side: scholar status benefits (tuition exemption at public institutions, visa and social security support).

score_reason: Generous co-funded master's in France; deadline soon after opening

name.en: CEU Master's Tuition & Stipend Awards and Doctoral Scholarship 2027–28
name.ka: CEU-ს სამაგისტრო სწავლის საფასურისა და სტიპენდიის გრანტები და სადოქტორო სტიპენდია 2027–28
name.ar: منح الرسوم والرواتب للماجستير ومنحة الدكتوراه في جامعة أوروبا الوسطى 2027–2028

deadline_note: Confirmed CEU 2027/28 deadlines: doctoral 15 Jan 2027; master's rounds 2 Feb, 15 Apr and 15 Jul 2027 (apply in an early round for the best aid chances).

summary.en: Central European University in Vienna gives merit-based master's awards covering 50–80% of tuition (exceptionally 100%) plus €300–750 monthly stipends, and fully funds PhD students with a €2,002 monthly stipend for four years. Applicants from any country can apply.
summary.ka: ვენის ცენტრალური ევროპის უნივერსიტეტი მაგისტრანტებს აძლევს სწავლის საფასურის 50–80%-ის (გამონაკლის შემთხვევაში 100%-ის) დამფარავ გრანტებს და თვეში €300–750 სტიპენდიას, ხოლო დოქტორანტებს სრულად აფინანსებს თვეში €2,002 სტიპენდიით ოთხი წლის განმავლობაში. განაცხადის შეტანა ნებისმიერი ქვეყნიდან შეიძლება.
summary.ar: تمنح جامعة أوروبا الوسطى في فيينا منحًا على أساس الجدارة لطلاب الماجستير تغطي 50–80% من الرسوم (و100% استثنائيًا) مع رواتب شهرية 300–750 يورو، وتموّل طلاب الدكتوراه بالكامل براتب 2,002 يورو شهريًا لأربع سنوات، والتقديم مفتوح لجميع الدول.

about.en:
CEU, the graduate-focused university founded by George Soros and now based in Vienna, is a long-standing destination for students from Georgia, the Caucasus and the wider region in social sciences, humanities, public policy, law, economics and more.

Master's financial aid is purely merit-based: a Master's Tuition Award covering 50% up to 80% of tuition (full tuition only in exceptional cases) and a Master's Stipend Award of €300–750 per month. All doctoral applicants who apply by the financial aid deadline are automatically considered for the CEU Doctoral Scholarship: full tuition plus a stipend of €2,002 gross per month for 48 months. There is no separate aid form for most programmes.

en: Master's: 50–80% tuition awards + €300–750/month stipends
PhD: full tuition + €2,002/month for 48 months
Open to applicants from any country, including Georgia and the Gulf

eligibility.en: Applicants from any country admitted to full-time CEU master's or doctoral programmes, selected on academic merit; English proficiency required.

en: Pick a CEU master's or PhD programme and check its specific requirements.
Apply online by the round deadline (PhD: 15 Jan 2027; master's: 2 Feb 2027 for early aid consideration).
Upload transcripts, CV, statement, references and English test (TOEFL/IELTS) results.
Aid decisions arrive with admission decisions (April 2027).

costs.en: Master's: tuition awards of 50–80% (exceptionally 100%) plus €300–750/month. PhD: tuition + €2,002 gross/month (taxable in Austria).

score_reason: Generous, open to all nationalities, confirmed deadlines

name.en: Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi Scholarships & Preferential Rates 2027–28
name.ka: სორბონის უნივერსიტეტის აბუ-დაბის ფილიალის სტიპენდიები და შეღავათიანი ტარიფები 2027–28
name.ar: منح جامعة السوربون أبوظبي والأسعار التفضيلية 2027–2028

deadline_note: Rolling: new students apply at registration; scholarship committee meets several times a year (apply at least 7 days before a committee meeting; first round recommended).

summary.en: Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi offers merit and circumstance-based scholarships to bachelor's and master's students of all nationalities, plus preferential tuition rates across all programmes, for French-style degrees in Abu Dhabi.
summary.ka: სორბონის უნივერსიტეტი აბუ-დაბიში ყველა ეროვნების ბაკალავრებსა და მაგისტრანტებს სთავაზობს აკადემიურ მოსწრებასა და პირად გარემოებებზე დაფუძნებულ სტიპენდიებს, ასევე შეღავათიან ტარიფებს ყველა პროგრამაზე.
summary.ar: تقدّم جامعة السوربون أبوظبي منحًا على أساس التفوق الأكاديمي أو الظروف الفردية لطلاب البكالوريوس والماجستير من جميع الجنسيات، إضافة إلى أسعار رسوم تفضيلية في جميع البرامج.

about.en:
Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi delivers degrees of Sorbonne University (Paris) in the UAE, in fields such as law, economics and management, history and international relations, philosophy, sociology, mathematics and physics, taught in French and English.

Scholarships based on academic excellence or individual circumstances are offered to both undergraduate and postgraduate students, and preferential tuition rates are available across all programmes. A University Scholarship Committee reviews complete applications; newly admitted students apply at registration, and continuing students apply each semester. Awards are limited, so early applications in the first round are strongly encouraged.

en: Merit- and need-based awards for all nationalities
Paris-Sorbonne degrees in Abu Dhabi
Preferential tuition rates on every programme

eligibility.en: Newly admitted and continuing undergraduate and postgraduate students at Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi, of any nationality, meeting the published eligibility criteria.

en: Apply for admission to Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi.
At registration, submit the online scholarship application with supporting documents.
Submit no later than 7 days before the Scholarship Committee meeting (first round recommended).
If awarded, pay the remaining fee or confirm an instalment plan within 20 days.

costs.en: Partial scholarships and preferential rates on tuition (amount set by the committee).

score_reason: Open to all; partial, amounts unpublished

org: Shota Rustaveli National Science Foundation of Georgia

name.en: Rustaveli Foundation Targeted Research Grant for Bachelor's Students 2026
name.ka: რუსთაველის ფონდის მიზნობრივი საგრანტო კონკურსი ბაკალავრიატის სტუდენტებისთვის 2026
name.ar: منحة مؤسسة روستافيلي البحثية لطلاب البكالوريوس 2026

deadline_note: Confirmed: electronic registration in GMUS from 30 Oct 2026 to 13 Nov 2026 18:00; signed declaration to the Foundation office by 17 Nov 2026 18:00.

summary.en: Georgia's national science foundation funds research projects led by bachelor's students, with up to GEL 15,000 per project, to spark scientific interest and innovative ideas among undergraduates. Applications are made with a host university.
summary.ka: შოთა რუსთაველის ეროვნული სამეცნიერო ფონდი აფინანსებს ბაკალავრიატის სტუდენტების კვლევით პროექტებს — თითო პროექტზე 15 000 ლარამდე — სტუდენტების სამეცნიერო ინტერესის გაღვივებისა და ინოვაციური იდეების წახალისებისთვის. განაცხადი შეაქვთ წამყვან ორგანიზაციასთან ერთად.
summary.ar: تموّل المؤسسة الوطنية للعلوم في جورجيا مشاريع بحثية يقودها طلاب البكالوريوس بما يصل إلى 15,000 لاري للمشروع، لتحفيز الاهتمام العلمي والأفكار المبتكرة، ويُقدَّم الطلب مع جامعة مضيفة.

about.en:
The Shota Rustaveli National Science Foundation's 2026 targeted grant competition for bachelor's students supports undergraduates enrolled in accredited bachelor's programmes in Georgia: it aims to spark and reward their scientific interests, identify innovative ideas and creative approaches and build research potential.

Applications are institutional: the student team (key personnel, who must be Georgian citizens studying in Georgia) applies together with a lead organisation such as their university. The amount requested from the Foundation may not exceed GEL 15,000 per project. Projects are registered online in the Foundation's GMUS system.

en: Up to GEL 15,000 for an undergraduate-led research project
Open now: registration closes 13 November 2026
Builds a research CV for master's and PhD applications abroad

eligibility.en: Bachelor's students enrolled in accredited programmes at Georgian higher education institutions, who are Georgian citizens, applying together with a lead (host) organisation.

en: Agree a project idea and supervisor with your university (lead organisation).
Register the project electronically in GMUS (gmus.rustaveli.org.ge) between 30 Oct and 13 Nov 2026, 18:00.
Submit the signed participation declaration to the Foundation's office by 17 Nov 2026, 18:00.
Await expert evaluation and results on rustaveli.org.ge.

costs.en: Project funding up to GEL 15,000 (research costs and remuneration of key personnel per Foundation rules).

score_reason: Open now with confirmed dates; research funding rather than tuition

name.en: Vilnius University Tuition Fee Waiver for Non-EU Master's Students 2027
name.ka: ვილნიუსის უნივერსიტეტის სწავლის საფასურისგან გათავისუფლება არაევროკავშირელი მაგისტრანტებისთვის 2027
name.ar: إعفاء جامعة فيلنيوس من الرسوم الدراسية لطلاب الماجستير من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي 2027

deadline_note: Estimated from the 2026 cycle (deadline 1 April 2026, interviews 4–14 May, results by 15 May). Confirm on vu.lt.

summary.en: Vilnius University waives the full tuition fee for the five most motivated and competent non-EU/EEA applicants to its English- or Russian-taught master's programmes.
summary.ka: ვილნიუსის უნივერსიტეტი სრულად ათავისუფლებს სწავლის საფასურისგან ინგლისურ ან რუსულენოვან სამაგისტრო პროგრამებზე შემოსულ ხუთ ყველაზე მოტივირებულ და კომპეტენტურ არაევროკავშირელ აპლიკანტს.
summary.ar: تعفي جامعة فيلنيوس أكثر خمسة متقدمين تحفيزًا وكفاءة من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي من كامل الرسوم في برامج الماجستير التي تُدرَّس بالإنجليزية أو الروسية.

about.en:
Vilnius University, Lithuania's oldest and top-ranked university, offers full tuition fee waivers to five non-EU/EEA students applying for master's programmes taught in English or Russian. Applicants simply tick the waiver box in the online application; selection is based on the entrance score and a short motivation interview held online.

It can be combined with applying for the Lithuanian state master's scholarship (which also pays a monthly stipend to citizens of eligible countries such as Georgia).

en: Zero tuition for the whole master's
Just tick a box in the application
Combine with the Lithuanian state stipend for eligible countries

eligibility.en: Non-EU/EEA citizens (including Georgia and the Gulf states) applying for a full-time master's at Vilnius University taught in English or Russian, with a strong academic record.

en: Choose a VU master's programme and apply via apply.vu.lt.
Tick the Tuition Fee Waiver box in the application form.
Submit by the waiver deadline (1 April in 2026).
Attend the virtual interview if shortlisted (May).

costs.en: Full tuition fee waiver; living costs not covered.

score_reason: Full tuition but only 5 awards

name.en: LCC International University Need-Based Aid & Scholarships 2027–28
name.ka: LCC International University-ის საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული დახმარება და სტიპენდიები 2027–28
name.ar: المساعدات المالية والمنح في جامعة LCC الدولية 2027–2028

deadline_note: Rolling: need-based aid and scholarships are reviewed with admission applications; apply early for Fall 2027 (LCC encourages early aid forms).

summary.en: LCC, an English-language liberal arts university in Klaipėda, Lithuania, gives need-based aid of 10–80% of tuition to 9 in 10 applicants and scholarships of 50–100%, with tuition of €4,500 a year.
summary.ka: LCC, ინგლისურენოვანი ლიბერალური ხელოვნების უნივერსიტეტი ლიტვის კლაიპედაში, 10-დან 9 აპლიკანტს აძლევს სწავლის საფასურის 10–80%-იან საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებულ დახმარებას და 50–100%-იან სტიპენდიებს; წლიური საფასური €4,500-ია.
summary.ar: تمنح جامعة LCC، وهي جامعة فنون حرة تدرّس بالإنجليزية في كلايبيدا بليتوانيا، مساعدات قائمة على الحاجة بنسبة 10–80% من الرسوم لتسعة من كل عشرة متقدمين، ومنحًا بنسبة 50–100%، والرسوم 4,500 يورو سنويًا.

about.en:
LCC International University is a small, English-speaking Christian liberal arts university in Klaipėda that recruits heavily from Eastern Europe, the Caucasus and Central Asia. Tuition for 2027/2028 is €4,500 per year (60 ECTS), and dormitories start at €575 per semester.

Students can apply for both Need-Based Aid (10–80% of tuition, received by 9 out of 10 applicants) and scholarships such as the Kenneth and Helen Penner Scholarship (100% for four years for the top incoming student), Leadership & Innovation, Peacemaker and Faith in Action scholarships (70% in year one) and Values or Partner grants (20%). Combined grants can cover up to 90% of tuition.

en: Need-based aid for 90% of applicants (10–80% of tuition)
Full four-year scholarship for the top entrant
Low base tuition (€4,500/year) in the EU

eligibility.en: International applicants admitted to LCC bachelor's programmes; need-based aid depends on family finances and entry scores; individual scholarships have their own criteria.

en: Apply for admission to LCC for Fall 2027.
Submit the online Need-Based Aid application form as early as possible.
Apply for named scholarships (essays/recommendations as required).
Receive a combined aid package with your admission decision.

costs.en: Need-based aid 10–80% of €4,500 tuition; scholarships 20–100%; total typically capped at 90% of tuition when combining.

score_reason: Affordable EU bachelor's with very common aid

name.en: Abu Dhabi University Scholarship for UAE Residents & GCC Students 2027–28 (15–50%)
name.ka: აბუ-დაბის უნივერსიტეტის სტიპენდია არაბთა გაერთიანებული საამიროების რეზიდენტებისა და GCC სტუდენტებისთვის 2027–28 (15–50%)
name.ar: منحة جامعة أبوظبي للمقيمين في الإمارات وطلبة دول الخليج 2027–2028 (15–50%)

deadline_note: Rolling: after admission, eligible scholarships appear in the student's ADU account and are applied for online; no re-application while maintenance criteria are met.

summary.en: Abu Dhabi University waives 15–50% of tuition for high-achieving UAE residents and GCC applicants (including Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman), and gives postgraduates with a 3.5+ GPA a 25% merit waiver.
summary.ka: აბუ-დაბის უნივერსიტეტი სწავლის საფასურის 15–50%-ს უთმობს წარჩინებულ საამიროების რეზიდენტებსა და GCC ქვეყნების (მათ შორის კატარის) აპლიკანტებს, ხოლო 3.5+ GPA-ის მქონე მაგისტრანტებს 25%-იან ფასდაკლებას აძლევს.
summary.ar: تعفي جامعة أبوظبي المتفوقين من المقيمين في الإمارات والمتقدمين من دول مجلس التعاون الخليجي (ومنها قطر والسعودية والكويت والبحرين وعُمان) من 15–50% من الرسوم، وتمنح طلبة الدراسات العليا بمعدل 3.5+ إعفاءً بنسبة 25%.

about.en:
Abu Dhabi University, one of the UAE's largest private universities with campuses in Abu Dhabi, Al Ain and Dubai, runs seven scholarship categories. The University Scholarship gives a 15% to 50% waiver on tuition fees for UAE residents and GCC candidates (GCC candidates must provide officially attested documents). Continuing students can earn an Academic Scholarship (20%) or Athletic Scholarship (25%), and postgraduate applicants with an undergraduate CGPA of at least 3.5 receive a 25% Merit-based Graduate Scholarship.

Awards last up to four years or until graduation. After admission, the student logs into the ADU account where all scholarships they qualify for appear, and applies online.

en: 15–50% tuition waiver for UAE residents and GCC applicants
25% graduate merit waiver for CGPA 3.5+
Simple online application after admission

eligibility.en: Admitted ADU students who are UAE residents or GCC nationals (with attested documents) and meet the merit criteria; graduate merit waiver requires an undergraduate CGPA ≥ 3.5.

en: Apply for admission to ADU and obtain your student ID.
Log in to your ADU account and open the Financial Aid and Scholarships section.
Apply online for the scholarships shown as available to you and upload any documents.
Meet the maintenance criteria each year to keep the award.

costs.en: Tuition waiver of 15–50% (University Scholarship); 20% (Academic), 25% (Athletic), 25% (Graduate merit).

score_reason: Explicitly open to GCC students incl. Qataris; partial

name.en: H.H. Sheikh Hamdan Bin Zayed Scholarship at Abu Dhabi University 2027–28
name.ka: შეიხ ჰამდან ბინ ზაიდის სტიპენდია აბუ-დაბის უნივერსიტეტში 2027–28
name.ar: منحة سمو الشيخ حمدان بن زايد في جامعة أبوظبي 2027–2028

deadline_note: Rolling: applied for through the ADU student account after admission when the student qualifies.

summary.en: ADU's top undergraduate award covers 100% of tuition plus the application, registration, student services and health service fees for outstanding students.
summary.ka: ADU-ის მთავარი საბაკალავრო სტიპენდია გამორჩეულ სტუდენტებს 100%-ით უფარავს სწავლის საფასურს, ასევე განაცხადის, რეგისტრაციის, სტუდენტური მომსახურებისა და ჯანდაცვის მომსახურების გადასახადებს.
summary.ar: تغطي أرفع منحة للبكالوريوس في جامعة أبوظبي 100% من الرسوم الدراسية إضافة إلى رسوم التقديم والتسجيل والخدمات الطلابية والخدمات الصحية للطلبة المتميزين.

about.en:
Named after H.H. Sheikh Hamdan Bin Zayed Al Nahyan, this is Abu Dhabi University's fully funded undergraduate scholarship: a 100% waiver on tuition, application fee, registration fee, student services fee and health service fee, for up to four years or until graduation.

As with all ADU scholarships, students do not submit a separate pre-admission form: once admitted, scholarships the student is eligible for, based on their academic record, appear in the ADU account and can be applied for online.

en: 100% tuition and fees waiver
ADU's most prestigious undergraduate award
Renewable up to four years

eligibility.en: Outstanding students admitted to ADU bachelor's programmes who meet the award's merit criteria (shown in the student account after admission); check nationality rules with ADU admissions.

en: Apply for admission to an ADU bachelor's programme with your best grades.
After admission, check your ADU account for the Sheikh Hamdan Bin Zayed Scholarship.
Complete the online application and upload documents.
Maintain the academic criteria every year.

costs.en: 100% waiver on tuition, application, registration, student services and health service fees.

score_reason: Full tuition, but eligibility only visible after admission

name.en: UAEU PhD Fellowship for All Nationalities — Fall 2027
name.ka: UAEU-ის სადოქტორო სტიპენდია ყველა ეროვნებისთვის — 2027 შემოდგომა
name.ar: زمالة الدكتوراه لجميع الجنسيات في جامعة الإمارات — خريف 2027

deadline_note: The fellowship deadline equals the UAEU graduate admission deadline for Fall 2027 (estimated 30 April 2027; check the CGS admission-cycle document).

summary.en: UAE University's PhD Fellowship gives high-achieving students of any nationality a full tuition waiver, a monthly stipend and health insurance for doctoral research in UAE priority sectors such as renewable energy, health, water, technology and space.
summary.ka: UAE University-ის სადოქტორო სტიპენდია ნებისმიერი ეროვნების წარჩინებულ სტუდენტებს აძლევს სწავლის საფასურისგან სრულ გათავისუფლებას, ყოველთვიურ სტიპენდიასა და ჯანმრთელობის დაზღვევას საამიროების პრიორიტეტულ სფეროებში (განახლებადი ენერგია, ჯანდაცვა, წყალი, ტექნოლოგიები, კოსმოსი) კვლევისთვის.
summary.ar: تمنح زمالة الدكتوراه في جامعة الإمارات العربية المتحدة المتفوقين من جميع الجنسيات إعفاءً كاملًا من الرسوم وراتبًا شهريًا وتأمينًا صحيًا لأبحاث الدكتوراه في القطاعات ذات الأولوية مثل الطاقة المتجددة والصحة والمياه والتكنولوجيا والفضاء.

about.en:
UAEU, the country's first national university in Al Ain, recruits high-achieving doctoral students in certain majors through its PhD Fellowship (All Nationalities). Awards are competitive and consider GPA, publications, conference presentations, patents, GRE scores, recommendation letters and the applicant's previous university.

The Full Package includes a full tuition waiver, a monthly stipend, health insurance and up to AED 3,000 (external project) or AED 2,000 (internal project) from the supervisor's research grant; fellows commit to 40 hours a week on study/research plus 5–10 hours of teaching or administrative assistance. A Basic Package (tuition waiver and insurance, with optional paid assistant work up to AED 4,000) is also offered. UAEU also has research, teaching and administrative assistantships open to all nationalities, and a 50% Chancellor's Merit Fellowship for graduate entrants with GPA ≥ 3.8.

en: Full tuition waiver + monthly stipend + insurance
Open to all nationalities
Priority research areas: energy, transport, health, water, tech, space

eligibility.en: Applicants of any nationality with a master's GPA ≥ 3.3/4.0, no employment or other sponsorship, a dissertation in a UAE priority sector, meeting UAEU PhD admission requirements.

en: Pick a UAEU PhD programme and potential supervisor.
Complete the UAEU graduate admission application before the Fall 2027 deadline.
Submit copies of all credentials (GPA, publications, GRE, recommendations) with the application.
Shortlisted candidates are interviewed; fellows sign the fellowship terms.

costs.en: Full Package: tuition waiver, monthly stipend, health insurance, up to AED 3,000/2,000 monthly top-up from supervisor's project. Basic Package: tuition waiver, insurance, optional assistant work up to AED 4,000.

score_reason: Funded PhD open to all nationalities incl. Georgians/Qataris

org: Ivane Javakhishvili Tbilisi State University (TSU) & European Commission (Erasmus+)

name.en: TSU Erasmus+ & Bilateral Exchange Scholarships for Students 2027
name.ka: თსუ-ს ერაზმუს+ და ორმხრივი გაცვლითი სტიპენდიები სტუდენტებისთვის 2027
name.ar: منح التبادل Erasmus+ والثنائية لطلاب جامعة تبليسي الحكومية 2027

duration.en: One semester (sometimes a full year) at a partner university
duration.ka: ერთი სემესტრი (ზოგჯერ სასწავლო წელი) პარტნიორ უნივერსიტეტში
duration.ar: فصل دراسي (وأحيانًا عام كامل) في جامعة شريكة

deadline_note: Rolling: TSU announces several calls a year (e.g. 12–23 Oct 2026 for spring 2027; rounds in May–July for the autumn semester). Check TSU's 'Current exchange' page.

summary.en: TSU regularly runs competitions for its bachelor's, master's and PhD students to win Erasmus+ International Credit Mobility and bilateral scholarships for a semester at partner universities across Europe.
summary.ka: თსუ რეგულარულად აცხადებს კონკურსებს ბაკალავრიატის, მაგისტრატურისა და დოქტორანტურის სტუდენტებისთვის ერაზმუს+ საერთაშორისო კრედიტ-მობილობისა და ორმხრივი სტიპენდიების მოსაპოვებლად ევროპის პარტნიორ უნივერსიტეტებში სემესტრით სწავლისთვის.
summary.ar: تطلق جامعة تبليسي الحكومية مسابقات منتظمة لطلاب البكالوريوس والماجستير والدكتوراه للفوز بمنح Erasmus+ للتنقل الدولي ومنح ثنائية لقضاء فصل دراسي في جامعات شريكة في أوروبا.

about.en:
Through Erasmus+ International Credit Mobility (funded by the European Commission) and bilateral agreements, Tbilisi State University sends students from all seven faculties to partner universities in Europe. Each call lists the available places by country, university and subject; applicants may apply to up to three universities per call.

Erasmus+ grants cover a monthly allowance set by the EU for the host country plus a travel contribution, and tuition is waived at the host. Separate calls exist for doctoral students and for specific partners. TSU's International Relations Department publishes all calls on its 'Current exchange' page with deadlines and document lists; questions go to outgoingmobility@tsu.ge (Erasmus+) or exchange@tsu.ge (bilateral).

en: EU-funded semester abroad with monthly allowance and travel grant
Calls several times a year for all study levels
Apply to up to three partner universities per call

eligibility.en: Active TSU bachelor's, master's and PhD students meeting each call's GPA and language requirements (international certificates or TSU's institutional language test).

en: Check TSU's 'Current exchange' page regularly for new calls.
Pick up to three partner universities from the call's list.
Prepare transcript, motivation letter, language certificate (or TSU institutional test result) and learning agreement draft.
Register and upload documents before the call deadline; attend interviews if invited.

costs.en: Erasmus+: EU monthly allowance (country-dependent) + travel support, host tuition waived. Bilateral: per partner agreement.

score_reason: Frequent, funded EU exchange route for Georgia's largest university

name.en: Georgian American University TOP Grant & Sopo Shubladze Scholarship 2027
name.ka: ქართულ-ამერიკული უნივერსიტეტის TOP გრანტი და სოფო შუბლაძის სტიპენდია 2027
name.ar: منحة TOP ومنحة سوفو شوبلادزه في الجامعة الجورجية الأمريكية 2027

deadline_note: Tied to the 2027 Unified National Exams (2026 UNE registration closed 11 May 2026); list the university as first priority when choosing programmes in summer 2027. Date estimated.

summary.en: Georgian American University gives full free tuition for a whole bachelor's degree to any applicant in the national top 1,000 of the Unified National Exams who ranks GAU first, plus an annual GEL 5,000 Sopo Shubladze university scholarship.
summary.ka: ქართულ-ამერიკული უნივერსიტეტი სრულად აფინანსებს მთელ საბაკალავრო პროგრამას იმ აბიტურიენტებისთვის, რომლებიც ერთიანი ეროვნული გამოცდების საუკეთესო 1000-ეულში მოხვდებიან და GAU-ს პირველ ადგილზე აირჩევენ; ასევე გაიცემა სოფო შუბლაძის სახელობის 5 000 ლარიანი ყოველწლიური სტიპენდია.
summary.ar: تمنح الجامعة الجورجية الأمريكية دراسة مجانية كاملة طوال البكالوريوس لكل متقدم ضمن أفضل 1,000 على مستوى البلاد في الامتحانات الوطنية يختارها أولًا، إضافة إلى منحة سنوية باسم سوفو شوبلادزه بقيمة 5,000 لاري.

about.en:
Georgian American University, a private university in Tbilisi teaching business, law, international relations, computer science, AI, engineering and humanities, offers a TOP Grant: applicants whose overall UNE ranking places them in the national top 1,000 and who put GAU first study for free within the 240 credits of the bachelor's programme (retaking or extra courses are paid by the student).

GAU also awards the annual Sopo Shubladze university scholarship of GEL 5,000, and publishes programme-by-programme fees and co-funding options.

en: Free bachelor's for national top-1,000 UNE scorers
GEL 5,000 annual Sopo Shubladze scholarship
Programmes in business, law, IR, CS, AI and engineering

eligibility.en: Applicants entering GAU bachelor's programmes through the 2027 Unified National Exams, ranked in the national top 1,000 and listing GAU first.

en: Register for the 2027 Unified National Exams.
Choose a GAU bachelor's programme as your first priority.
Reach the national top 1,000; the TOP Grant is applied on enrolment.
Ask GAU about the Sopo Shubladze scholarship application once enrolled.

costs.en: TOP Grant: 100% tuition for 240 credits. Sopo Shubladze scholarship: GEL 5,000 per year.

score_reason: Full tuition for top 1,000 scorers

name.en: Alte University Full Funding for Top UNE Scorers, Medallists & Olympiad Winners 2027
name.ka: ალტე უნივერსიტეტის სრული დაფინანსება საუკეთესო აბიტურიენტებისთვის, მედალოსნებისა და ოლიმპიადის გამარჯვებულებისთვის 2027
name.ar: التمويل الكامل في جامعة ألتي لأوائل الامتحانات الوطنية وحاملي الميداليات والفائزين بالأولمبياد 2027

deadline_note: Tied to the 2027 Unified National Exams (2026 UNE registration closed 11 May 2026); list the university as first priority when choosing programmes in summer 2027. Date estimated.

summary.en: Alte University funds 100% of tuition for national top-1,000 UNE applicants who choose it first, national olympiad winners entering computer science, AI or business, and the top 10 medicine entrants (sponsored by VIAN); school gold and silver medallists get 50%.
summary.ka: ალტე უნივერსიტეტი 100%-ით აფინანსებს სწავლას ერთიანი ეროვნული გამოცდების საუკეთესო 1000-ეულის აბიტურიენტებისთვის, რომლებიც მას პირველ პრიორიტეტად აირჩევენ, ეროვნული ოლიმპიადის გამარჯვებულებისთვის კომპიუტერულ მეცნიერებაზე, AI-სა და ბიზნესზე და მედიცინის ტოპ-10 აბიტურიენტისთვის (VIAN-ის დაფინანსებით); ოქროსა და ვერცხლის მედალოსნები 50%-ს იღებენ.
summary.ar: تموّل جامعة ألتي 100% من الرسوم لأفضل 1,000 متقدم وطنيًا يختارونها أولًا، وللفائزين بالأولمبياد الوطني في علوم الحاسب والذكاء الاصطناعي وإدارة الأعمال، ولأفضل 10 مقبولين في الطب (برعاية VIAN)، ويحصل حاملو الميداليات الذهبية والفضية على 50%.

about.en:
Alte University in Tbilisi runs a broad merit funding scheme for UNE entrants: 100% funding for any applicant in the national UNE top 1,000 who chooses Alte first; 50% for school gold and silver medallists who choose Alte first; 100% for the top 10 entrants to the medicine programme, paid by the company VIAN; 100% for national olympiad winners entering computer science, artificial intelligence or business administration; and 100% for entrants to business, computer science and AI who score at least 60% of the maximum in the elective subject (physics or mathematics).

The last rule makes Alte one of the most accessible fully funded options in Georgia for strong maths/physics students.

en: 100% for national top 1,000, olympiad winners and top 10 in medicine
100% for business/CS/AI entrants with ≥60% in maths or physics
50% for gold/silver medallists

eligibility.en: Applicants entering Alte University bachelor's programmes via the 2027 Unified National Exams (first priority for the top-1,000 and medal grants).

en: Register for the 2027 Unified National Exams.
Choose Alte University first (and the relevant programme: medicine, CS, AI or business).
Achieve the qualifying rank/score or present your olympiad diploma or medal.
Funding is applied on enrolment under Alte's funding rules document.

costs.en: 100% or 50% of tuition depending on the scheme.

score_reason: Very accessible full funding for maths/physics-strong students

org: St. Andrew the First-Called Georgian University (SANGU) & Northern Kentucky University

name.en: SANGU–Northern Kentucky University Dual Master's in Cybersecurity — Full Funding 2027
name.ka: SANGU–ჩრდილოეთ კენტუკის უნივერსიტეტის ორმაგი სამაგისტრო პროგრამა კიბერუსაფრთხოებაში — სრული დაფინანსება 2027
name.ar: ماجستير مزدوج في الأمن السيبراني بين جامعة القديس أندرو الجورجية وجامعة شمال كنتاكي — تمويل كامل 2027

deadline_note: Admission requires the Common Master's Exams, whose registration ran with the UNE (closed 11 May in 2026). Date estimated for 2027.

summary.en: A fully funded two-year master's in cybersecurity in Tbilisi that awards both a Georgian (SANGU) and an American (Northern Kentucky University) degree.
summary.ka: სრულად დაფინანსებული ორწლიანი სამაგისტრო პროგრამა კიბერუსაფრთხოებაში თბილისში, რომლის კურსდამთავრებულები ქართულ (SANGU) და ამერიკულ (ჩრდილოეთ კენტუკის უნივერსიტეტი) ხარისხს იღებენ.
summary.ar: ماجستير ممول بالكامل لمدة عامين في الأمن السيبراني في تبليسي يمنح شهادتين: جورجية (SANGU) وأمريكية (جامعة شمال كنتاكي).

about.en:
St. Andrew the First-Called Georgian University of the Patriarchate of Georgia (SANGU) runs a master's programme in cybersecurity jointly with Northern Kentucky University (USA). Graduates receive a dual degree: Master of Science in Cybersecurity from SANGU and from NKU.

The annual tuition is listed as fully funded. The programme lasts two years (at least 120 ECTS). Applicants must pass Georgia's Common Master's Exam plus the programme's own requirements.

en: Free tuition for a US–Georgian dual master's degree
Cybersecurity, a high-demand field
Study in Tbilisi with American curriculum

eligibility.en: Bachelor's degree holders eligible for Georgia's Common Master's Exams (Georgian citizens and eligible residents), meeting SANGU/NKU English and programme requirements.

en: Register for the 2027 Common Master's Exam with NAEC.
Meet SANGU's internal exam/interview and English requirements.
Apply to the SANGU cybersecurity master's programme.
Enrol in autumn 2027.

costs.en: Tuition fully funded.

score_reason: Free US dual degree in a hot field

name.en: Georgian Technical University Named Scholarships & RMG Engineering Scholarship 2027
name.ka: საქართველოს ტექნიკური უნივერსიტეტის სახელობითი სტიპენდიები და RMG-ის სასტიპენდიო პროგრამა 2027
name.ar: المنح الاسمية ومنحة RMG للهندسة في جامعة جورجيا التقنية 2027

deadline_note: Rolling: GTU announces named and sponsor scholarships each semester; check GTU's scholarships page.

summary.en: Georgia's main technical university awards faculty scholarships named after Niko Nikoladze, David Sarajishvili and Akaki Khoshtaria, a scholarship from mining company RMG for engineering students, 'green' scholarships and the state scholarship for successful students.
summary.ka: საქართველოს ტექნიკური უნივერსიტეტი გასცემს ნიკო ნიკოლაძის, დავით სარაჯიშვილისა და აკაკი ხოშტარიას სახელობის საფაკულტეტო სტიპენდიებს, სამთო კომპანია RMG-ის სტიპენდიას საინჟინრო მიმართულების სტუდენტებისთვის, „მწვანე სტიპენდიებს“ და სახელმწიფო სტიპენდიას.
summary.ar: تمنح جامعة جورجيا التقنية منحًا للكليات باسم نيكو نيكولادزه وديفيد ساراجيشفيلي وأكاكي خوشتاريا، ومنحة من شركة التعدين RMG لطلاب الهندسة، و«منحًا خضراء»، والمنحة الحكومية للطلاب المتفوقين.

about.en:
Georgian Technical University (GTU) in Tbilisi offers several scholarships for motivated, successful students: faculty named scholarships (Niko Nikoladze, David Sarajishvili, Akaki Khoshtaria), the Zviad Gamsakhurdia presidential scholarship for law and related students, the RMG Scholarship Programme from the largest mining company in the South Caucasus (to discover and support motivated engineering students), Green Scholarships under the programme on climate-related disaster risk reduction in Georgia, the Tamaz Bekaia Educational Foundation scholarship, and the state programme 'State Scholarships for Students' (GEL 150 per month per semester at state universities).

These stack with UNE state grants and help engineering students cover living costs.

en: Industry-funded RMG scholarship for engineering students
Named faculty and 'green' climate scholarships
State stipend for successful students

eligibility.en: Students enrolled at GTU meeting each scholarship's academic and field criteria (e.g. engineering majors for RMG).

en: Enrol at GTU (via the Unified National Exams for bachelor's).
Watch GTU's scholarships page and faculty announcements each semester.
Apply with your transcript and documents required by each scholarship.

costs.en: Varies by scholarship: monthly stipends or one-off awards; state scholarship GEL 150/month.

score_reason: Several modest stipends for engineering students

name.en: Batumi State University Scholarships (Bank of Georgia, Badri Patarkatsishvili Fund, University Named Awards) 2027
name.ka: ბათუმის შოთა რუსთაველის სახელმწიფო უნივერსიტეტის სტიპენდიები (საქართველოს ბანკი, გუდავაძე-პატარკაციშვილის ფონდი, სახელობითი) 2027
name.ar: منح جامعة باتومي الحكومية (بنك جورجيا، صندوق باتاركاتسيشفيلي، منح اسمية) 2027

deadline_note: Rolling: competitions announced by BSU each semester/academic year.

summary.en: Batumi State University offers named university scholarships for excellent bachelor's and master's students, a Bank of Georgia scholarship, a Gudavadze-Patarkatsishvili foundation scholarship, a Tamaz Bekaia foundation scholarship and university-funded support for high-achieving students from vulnerable families.
summary.ka: ბათუმის სახელმწიფო უნივერსიტეტი წარჩინებულ ბაკალავრებსა და მაგისტრანტებს სთავაზობს საუნივერსიტეტო სახელობით სტიპენდიებს, საქართველოს ბანკის, გუდავაძე-პატარკაციშვილისა და თამაზ ბექაიას ფონდების სტიპენდიებს და დახმარებას სოციალურად დაუცველი წარჩინებული სტუდენტებისთვის.
summary.ar: تقدّم جامعة باتومي الحكومية منحًا جامعية اسمية لطلاب البكالوريوس والماجستير المتفوقين، ومنحة بنك جورجيا، ومنحة صندوق غودافادزه-باتاركاتسيشفيلي، ومنحة صندوق تاماز بيكايا، ودعمًا للمتفوقين من الأسر المحتاجة.

about.en:
Batumi Shota Rustaveli State University, the main public university of the Adjara region on the Black Sea coast, runs several scholarship lines: university named scholarships for top bachelor's and master's students with research achievements; awards for excellent and socially vulnerable students from the second year; a scholarship for first-year students who list BSU first in the Unified National Exams and achieve high results; and sponsor scholarships from the Bank of Georgia, the Gudavadze-Patarkatsishvili Foundation and the Tamaz Bekaia Foundation.

Socially vulnerable high-achieving students can also receive tuition support from the university budget on a competitive basis.

en: Bank of Georgia and private foundation scholarships
Award for first-year students who choose BSU first
Support for socially vulnerable high achievers

eligibility.en: Students enrolled at BSU (some awards for first-year entrants via UNE who rank BSU first; others from the second year, based on grades, research and social status).

en: Choose BSU as first priority in the Unified National Exams (for the first-year award).
Watch BSU's scholarships page for competitions each semester.
Submit the application with transcript and, where relevant, social-status documents.

costs.en: Monthly stipends or tuition support depending on the scholarship.

score_reason: Regional options outside Tbilisi; amounts modest

name.en: TalTech Scholarship for International Olympiad Medallists 2027 (€400–800/month)
name.ka: TalTech-ის სტიპენდია საერთაშორისო ოლიმპიადების მედალოსნებისთვის 2027 (თვეში €400–800)
name.ar: منحة TalTech للحاصلين على ميداليات الأولمبياد الدولية 2027 (400–800 يورو شهريًا)

duration.en: Monthly, for the nominal length of the bachelor's

deadline_note: Confirmed rule: scholarship applications are due by 15 September of the year of admission (TalTech bachelor's admission deadlines for internationals fall earlier in the year).

summary.en: Estonia's technical university pays €800 a month to gold, €600 to silver and €400 to bronze medallists of international olympiads (IMO, IPhO, IOI, IChO, IBO and others) who enrol in its bachelor's programmes, for the whole degree.
summary.ka: ესტონეთის ტექნიკური უნივერსიტეტი საერთაშორისო ოლიმპიადების (IMO, IPhO, IOI, IChO, IBO და სხვ.) ოქროს მედალოსნებს თვეში €800-ს, ვერცხლისას €600-ს და ბრინჯაოსას €400-ს უხდის მთელი ბაკალავრიატის განმავლობაში.
summary.ar: تدفع جامعة تالين التقنية في إستونيا 800 يورو شهريًا للحاصلين على الذهب و600 للفضة و400 للبرونز في الأولمبيادات الدولية (IMO وIPhO وIOI وIChO وIBO وغيرها) الملتحقين ببرامج البكالوريوس فيها، طوال مدة الدراسة.

about.en:
Tallinn University of Technology's Office of Academic Affairs pays a monthly scholarship to students admitted to TalTech bachelor's programmes who won medals at international subject olympiads in the three years before enrolment. Eligible olympiads: IMO, IPhO, EuPhO, IOI, IOAA, IChO, IESO, IGO, IBO and TalTech's Nordic–Baltic Physics Olympiad.

The award is €800/month for gold, €600 for silver and €400 for bronze, paid from September of the year of admission for the nominal study period, provided the student keeps a GPA of at least 4.0 (on Estonia's 0–5 scale). Students apply with a signed application and the olympiad certificate to their faculty dean's office.

en: €400–800 per month for the whole bachelor's
Rewards IMO/IPhO/IOI/IChO/IBO and other medals
English-taught engineering and IT degrees in the EU

eligibility.en: Students of any nationality admitted to a TalTech bachelor's programme who won a medal at a listed international olympiad within the three years before matriculation; must maintain GPA ≥ 4.0.

en: Apply for admission to a TalTech English-taught bachelor's programme (international deadlines in early 2027).
After admission, submit a digitally signed free-form application with your bank account to your faculty dean's office.
Attach the certificate confirming your olympiad medal.
Submit by 15 September 2027; keep GPA ≥ 4.0 to continue receiving it.

costs.en: €800 (gold), €600 (silver) or €400 (bronze) per month.

score_reason: Strong reward for olympiad medallists from Georgia and the Gulf

name.en: Özyeğin University Scholarships for International Students 2027–28 (40–60%)
name.ka: ოზიეგინის უნივერსიტეტის სტიპენდიები უცხოელი სტუდენტებისთვის 2027–28 (40–60%)
name.ar: منح جامعة أوزيغين للطلاب الدوليين 2027–2028 (40–60%)

deadline_note: Rolling admissions for international students; all applicants are automatically considered for a scholarship with no separate application.

summary.en: Istanbul's Özyeğin University automatically considers every international applicant for a 40%, 50% or 60% tuition scholarship on a standard fee of US$25,000 a year.
summary.ka: სტამბოლის ოზიეგინის უნივერსიტეტი ყველა უცხოელ აპლიკანტს ავტომატურად განიხილავს 40%-იანი, 50%-იანი ან 60%-იანი სტიპენდიისთვის წლიურ $25,000 სტანდარტულ საფასურზე.
summary.ar: تدرس جامعة أوزيغين في إسطنبول كل متقدم دولي تلقائيًا لمنحة دراسية بنسبة 40% أو 50% أو 60% من الرسوم القياسية البالغة 25,000 دولار سنويًا.

about.en:
Özyeğin University is a private, English-medium research university on the Asian side of Istanbul, known for engineering, business, economics, law, architecture, hospitality and aviation. For 2026-27 the standard international tuition is about US$25,000 per year, but scholarships are available to successful applicants based on their academic profile.

All applicants are automatically evaluated for scholarships, with sample awards of 40%, 50% and 60% published by the university; no separate scholarship application is needed. Scholarships do not apply to the Professional Flight programme.

en: Automatic 40–60% scholarships, no extra form
English-taught degrees in Istanbul
Strong engineering, business and international relations programmes

eligibility.en: International applicants to Özyeğin bachelor's programmes (including citizens of Georgia and the Gulf states) meeting admission criteria; award level depends on academic results.

en: Apply online through Özyeğin's international admissions portal.
Upload transcripts, diploma/predicted grades, passport and test scores (SAT/IB/A-levels or national exam results as accepted).
Receive your admission decision with the scholarship rate.
Confirm your place by paying the deposit.

costs.en: 40%, 50% or 60% off tuition (standard rate about US$25,000/year); not applicable to Professional Flight.

score_reason: Automatic sizeable discount close to Georgia

org: Sultan Qaboos University & Higher Education Admission Centre (Oman)

name.en: Sultan Qaboos University GCC Countries Scholarships Program 2027–28
name.ka: სულთან კაბუსის უნივერსიტეტის სასტიპენდიო პროგრამა GCC ქვეყნებისთვის 2027–28
name.ar: برنامج منح دول مجلس التعاون الخليجي في جامعة السلطان قابوس 2027–2028

deadline_note: Two routes: via GCC embassies (dates set by each country) or via Oman's Higher Education Admission Centre (HEAC) for GCC students schooled in Oman, following HEAC's annual cycle.

summary.en: Oman's flagship Sultan Qaboos University offers scholarships to citizens of GCC countries (Qatar, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain), either nominated through their embassies or, if they finished Grade 12 in Oman, through Oman's central admission centre.
summary.ka: ომანის წამყვანი სულთან კაბუსის უნივერსიტეტი სტიპენდიებს სთავაზობს GCC ქვეყნების (კატარი, საუდის არაბეთი, საამიროები, ქუვეითი, ბაჰრეინი) მოქალაქეებს — საელჩოების ნომინაციით ან, ომანში მე-12 კლასის დამთავრების შემთხვევაში, ომანის ერთიანი მიღების ცენტრის გავლით.
summary.ar: تقدّم جامعة السلطان قابوس، الجامعة الأولى في عُمان، منحًا لمواطني دول مجلس التعاون (قطر والسعودية والإمارات والكويت والبحرين) عبر ترشيح سفاراتهم، أو عبر مركز القبول الموحد إذا أنهوا الصف الثاني عشر في عُمان.

about.en:
Sultan Qaboos University (SQU) in Muscat runs a GCC Countries Scholarships Program with two tracks. Through Embassies: GCC governments nominate their citizens for SQU seats under Gulf cooperation agreements. Through HEAC: GCC students who completed Grade 12 at an Omani school or an international school in Oman apply via the Higher Education Admission Centre, using the admission criteria in HEAC's GCC guidebook.

SQU is Oman's top public university with colleges of medicine, engineering, science, agriculture, economics and political science, law, education and arts.

en: Scholarship seats reserved for GCC nationals
Embassy nomination or central HEAC application
Oman's leading research university

eligibility.en: Citizens of GCC countries: nominated by their governments/embassies, or GCC nationals who completed Grade 12 in Oman (HEAC route), meeting SQU admission criteria.

en: GCC students abroad: ask your Ministry of Education or your embassy in Muscat about SQU nominations.
GCC students schooled in Oman: apply through HEAC (heac.gov.om) during its admission window, following the GCC guidebook.
Submit school certificates and identity documents as required.
Accept the SQU offer and scholarship.

costs.en: Scholarship for undergraduate study at SQU under the GCC programme (tuition and benefits per agreement).

score_reason: Specific GCC route; little public detail on benefits

name.en: King Saud University External Scholarships for International Students 2027–28
name.ka: მეფე საუდის უნივერსიტეტის გარე სტიპენდიები უცხოელი სტუდენტებისთვის 2027–28
name.ar: المنح الخارجية لجامعة الملك سعود للطلاب الدوليين 2027–2028

duration.en: Bachelor's programme (plus Arabic diploma if needed)
duration.ka: საბაკალავრო პროგრამა (საჭიროების შემთხვევაში არაბული ენის დიპლომით)
duration.ar: برنامج البكالوريوس (مع دبلوم اللغة العربية عند الحاجة)

deadline_note: Estimated: the application window is published on KSU's External Scholarships portal; the most recent official flyer showed 18 August – 18 September. Confirm the 2027 timeline on the portal.

summary.en: King Saud University in Riyadh offers external scholarships to international applicants living outside Saudi Arabia for bachelor's degrees in engineering, computing, sciences, business, agriculture and architecture, with tuition exemption, housing and travel benefits.

summary.ar: تقدّم جامعة الملك سعود في الرياض منحًا خارجية للمتقدمين الدوليين المقيمين خارج المملكة لدراسة البكالوريوس في الهندسة والحاسب والعلوم وإدارة الأعمال والزراعة والعمارة، مع إعفاء من الرسوم وسكن وتذاكر سفر.

about.en:
King Saud University, Saudi Arabia's oldest and largest university, admits international students through external scholarships at three levels: Arabic-language diplomas (including the intensive diploma for non-Arabic speakers), bachelor's degrees, and postgraduate studies.

For bachelor's external scholarships, applicants must hold a recognised high-school diploma obtained within the last five years, a valid SAT score of at least 1010 (1200 for medicine), be aged 17–25, have home-government approval where required, not hold another Saudi scholarship, and pass a medical exam (plus interview/tests for medicine, dentistry and architecture). Programmes on the scholarship list include electrical, chemical, industrial, civil, mechanical and petroleum engineering, computer science and software engineering, mathematics, actuarial science, chemistry, agriculture, economics and business. KSU's benefits page lists a monthly allowance of SAR 1,000 (science programmes) or SAR 850 (other programmes) for bachelor's external scholars (SAR 900 for postgraduates), university housing, discounted meals, a two-month settling-in allowance on arrival and a three-month graduation allowance for shipping books, on top of free tuition.

en: Free bachelor's at Saudi Arabia's largest university
SAT ≥ 1010 route open to all nationalities
Engineering, computing, science and business programmes

eligibility.en: International applicants living outside Saudi Arabia, aged 17–25, with a recognised secondary diploma from the last five years, SAT ≥ 1010 (≥1200 for medicine), attested documents, medical fitness and no other Saudi scholarship.

en: Take the SAT and obtain a score of at least 1010.
Have your secondary certificates attested.
Apply online via KSU's External Scholarships portal (linked from the International Students Department page) when the window opens.
Attend interviews/tests if your programme requires them; accept the offer.

costs.en: Free tuition; monthly allowance SAR 1,000 (sciences) / SAR 850 (other fields); university housing; discounted meals; 2-month arrival allowance; 3-month graduation allowance.

score_reason: Full scholarship with a clear SAT route; window estimated

summary.ka: ქუვეითის უნივერსიტეტი ყოველწლიურად 15 სასტიპენდიო ადგილს უთმობს ქუვეითის ერთიანი სასკოლო სისტემის წარჩინებულ არაქუვეითელ კურსდამთავრებულებს და კულტურულ სტიპენდიებს სთავაზობს პარტნიორ ქვეყნებს; ქუვეითში სკოლადამთავრებული GCC მოქალაქეები ქუვეითელებთან ერთად კონკურსობენ.
summary.ar: تخصص جامعة الكويت سنويًا 15 مقعدًا دراسيًا للمتفوقين غير الكويتيين من خريجي النظام الموحد، وتقدّم منحًا ثقافية لدول وجهات رسمية، ويتنافس مواطنو دول الخليج خريجو المدارس الكويتية على القبول مع الكويتيين.

about.en:
Kuwait University's admissions rules list several categories of applicants. Under the Outstanding Students' Scholarship, the university allocates 15 seats each year to outstanding non-Kuwaiti graduates of Kuwait's unified (government) secondary system. It also offers a number of cultural scholarships to various countries or official entities under agreements with the State of Kuwait.

GCC nationals who completed all years of secondary school in Kuwaiti high schools can apply alongside Kuwaiti students for seats in all faculties, and a separate category of 100 seats exists for stateless residents and children of non-Kuwaiti fathers. Applications are submitted online through the KU admission portal.

en: 15 scholarship seats for top non-Kuwaiti school graduates
Cultural scholarships for partner countries
GCC nationals schooled in Kuwait compete equally

eligibility.en: Outstanding non-Kuwaiti graduates of Kuwait's unified secondary system (scholarship seats); citizens of partner countries via official cultural scholarship nominations; GCC nationals who completed secondary school in Kuwait (regular admission).

en: Check Kuwait University's 'How to apply' page for your applicant category.
Apply online during the summer admission window with your secondary certificate.
For cultural scholarships, contact your Ministry of Education or Kuwait's embassy.
Contact the KU scholarships office for specifics.

costs.en: Scholarship seats cover tuition at Kuwait University; cultural scholarships per agreement.

score_reason: Narrow eligibility and no published dates

summary.ka: ომანის მთავრობა საუკეთესო ომანელ აბიტურიენტებს სრული სტიპენდიით აგზავნის რეკომენდებულ უცხოურ უნივერსიტეტებში, MoHERI-ს მიერ დადგენილი დახმარებებითა და ომანის კულტურული ატაშეების მხარდაჭერით.
summary.ar: تبتعث حكومة سلطنة عُمان المتفوقين من خريجي دبلوم التعليم العام إلى جامعات موصى بها في الخارج ببعثات كاملة، مع مخصصات مالية تحددها وزارة التعليم العالي ودعم من الملحقيات الثقافية.

about.en:
MoHERI's External Scholarships (al-bi'that al-kharijiya) fund Omani students for bachelor's study at universities on the ministry's list of recommended foreign universities. Students register for external scholarships through the Higher Education Admission Centre's unified system, competing on their General Education Diploma results and the programme's requirements.

MoHERI publishes the registration mechanism, country guides (including countries supervised by the cultural attaché in Washington), visa and immigration information, and the rules and amounts of financial allocations for scholarship students abroad.

en: Full government scholarship to recommended universities abroad
Monthly allocations and support from Omani cultural attachés
Single application through HEAC

eligibility.en: Omani nationals completing the General Education Diploma who meet the grade and programme requirements set in the HEAC student guide.

en: Read the HEAC student guide for the year and the list of recommended foreign universities on moheri.gov.om.
Register for external scholarship programmes in the HEAC system during the registration period.
Accept your offer and follow MoHERI's procedure for opening a scholarship file.
Obtain admission and visa with guidance from the cultural attaché.

costs.en: Tuition and living allocations per MoHERI rules for students on scholarships abroad.

score_reason: Main state route for Omanis; dates set annually by HEAC

summary.en: Oman's National Programme for Postgraduate Studies sends talented Omanis to the world's best universities for master's and doctoral degrees in academic and medical tracks, plus university grants.
summary.ka: ომანის ეროვნული პროგრამა უმაღლესი საფეხურის სწავლისთვის ნიჭიერ ომანელებს მსოფლიოს საუკეთესო უნივერსიტეტებში აგზავნის მაგისტრატურასა და დოქტორანტურაზე აკადემიურ და სამედიცინო მიმართულებებით.

about.en:
Following royal directives, Oman continued its National Programme for Postgraduate Studies within the 10th five-year plan, in two phases. It covers an academic track, a medical track and a university-grants track, with the aim of sending Omani talent to the best universities worldwide and strengthening scientific and technical exchange.

MoHERI's Postgraduate and Scholarships Department follows the students and also manages scholarships offered to Oman by other countries and institutions (announced on its 'Scholarship announcements' page, e.g. offers from the EU, IsDB, Hungary, Switzerland, Japan and Korean universities). External postgraduate grants are registered through the unified admission centre and announced in the postgraduate student guide.

en: Master's and PhD at top universities worldwide
Academic and medical tracks
Also lists foreign-government scholarships offered to Omanis

eligibility.en: Omani nationals meeting the postgraduate guide's academic criteria (degree classification, admission to a top-ranked university in a priority field).

en: Read MoHERI's postgraduate student guide for the cycle.
Secure admission (or apply) to a recommended top university in a priority field.
Register through the Higher Education Admission Centre during the announced window.
Check MoHERI's 'Scholarship announcements' page for additional foreign-government offers.

costs.en: Full funding (tuition, allowances) under MoHERI's rules for postgraduate scholars abroad.

summary.ar: تمنح جامعة الإمارات خصمًا بنسبة 50% على الرسوم لطلبة الماجستير والدكتوراه المقبولين حديثًا بمعدل 3.8/4.0 فأعلى، خصوصًا في مجالات STEM والمجالات الاستراتيجية، حتى التخرج.

about.en:
The Chancellor's Fellowship for Graduate Students (master's and doctoral) aims to attract excellent students to UAEU. Its Merit Fellowship Award for Newly Admitted Students gives a partial tuition waiver of 50% to applicants with excellent academic standing (GPA ≥ 3.8/4.0), primarily in STEM and strategic areas; it does not apply to education programmes or the DBA.

The award stays valid until graduation as long as the student keeps a GPA of 3.8 or more. A separate Merit Fellowship exists for high-achieving continuing students, and UAEU also offers research, teaching and administrative assistantships to all nationalities.

en: 50% off graduate tuition for GPA 3.8+
Valid until graduation
Open to all nationalities

eligibility.en: Newly admitted UAEU master's/doctoral students of any nationality with GPA ≥ 3.8/4.0 (primarily STEM/strategic programmes; excludes education programmes and DBA), subject to budget.

en: Apply for admission to a UAEU graduate programme for Fall 2027.
Apply for the Chancellor's Merit Fellowship before the admission deadline.
Maintain GPA ≥ 3.8 to keep the award.

costs.en: 50% discount on tuition fees.

score_reason: Half tuition for very high GPAs

summary.ka: აგრარული უნივერსიტეტი (კახა ბენდუქიძის საუნივერსიტეტო კამპუსი) აბიტურიენტებს სთავაზობს სასწავლო გრანტს „საუკეთესო – საუკეთესოებს“, „საგზურს“ სოციალურად დაუცველი სტუდენტებისთვის, საქართველოს ბანკის სტიპენდიას და შემეცნებითი კონკურსებით მოპოვებულ გრანტებს.
summary.ar: تقدّم جامعة جورجيا الزراعية (ضمن حرم كاخا بنديوكيدزه الجامعي) للمقبولين عبر الامتحانات الوطنية منحة «الأفضل للأفضل»، ومنحة «ساغزوري» للطلاب المحتاجين، ومنحة بنك جورجيا، ومنحًا تُكتسب عبر مسابقات معرفية.

about.en:
The Agricultural University of Georgia (AUG) in Tbilisi, a private university known for agriculture, engineering, natural sciences and its strong maths and physics programmes, publishes a tuition table by state-grant level and several funding options for each admission year.

For 2026 admission these included: the Bank of Georgia scholarship for students (stipendia.bog.ge); 'Sagzuri' for socially vulnerable students admitted through the national exams; the study grant 'Best to the Best' (saukeTeso – saukeTesoebs) for top entrants; and knowledge competitions held during the year that give applicants an extra chance to win study grants. AUG shares the campus and funding philosophy of Free University (Kakha Bendukidze).

en: Merit grant 'Best to the Best' for top entrants
'Sagzuri' grant for socially vulnerable students
Competitions during the year to win study grants

eligibility.en: Applicants admitted to AUG bachelor's programmes through the 2027 Unified National Exams; Sagzuri requires official socially vulnerable status; competition grants for participants in AUG's knowledge competitions.

en: Check AUG's financing page for the 2027 package.
Take part in AUG's knowledge competitions during the school year (extra grant chance).
Sit the 2027 UNE and choose an AUG programme.
Apply for the Bank of Georgia scholarship via stipendia.bog.ge if eligible.

costs.en: Tuition reductions or full coverage depending on the grant; tuition depends on the state-grant level.

score_reason: Several grant routes; details only on JS page

summary.en: Poland's Banach programme, a development-aid initiative of the Foreign Ministry and NAWA, funds citizens of 36 Polish Aid countries in Eastern Europe, Asia, Africa and Latin America to do a full master's in Polish or English at Polish public universities.
summary.ka: პოლონეთის ბანახის პროგრამა — საგარეო საქმეთა სამინისტროსა და NAWA-ს განვითარების დახმარების ინიციატივა — აფინანსებს Polish Aid-ის 36 ქვეყნის (აღმოსავლეთ ევროპა, აზია, აფრიკა, ლათინური ამერიკა) მოქალაქეების სრულ მაგისტრატურას პოლონურ ან ინგლისურ ენაზე პოლონეთის სახელმწიფო უნივერსიტეტებში.
summary.ar: يموّل برنامج باناخ البولندي، وهو مبادرة مساعدات تنموية لوزارة الخارجية والوكالة الوطنية للتبادل الأكاديمي (NAWA)، مواطني 36 دولة من دول المساعدات البولندية في أوروبا الشرقية وآسيا وأفريقيا وأمريكا اللاتينية لدراسة الماجستير كاملًا بالبولندية أو الإنجليزية في جامعات بولندا الحكومية.

about.en:
The Banach NAWA programme offers scholarships for full-time second-cycle (master's) studies taught in Polish or English at universities supervised by Poland's Minister of Science and Higher Education. Its goal is to support the socio-economic development of developing countries by raising the education and professional qualifications of their citizens.

It is open to citizens of the 36 countries covered by Polish Aid in Eastern Europe, Asia, Africa and Latin America (Georgia is one of Polish Aid's long-standing Eastern Partnership priority countries; check the country list in the call). The 2026 call (16/2026) was published on 13 April 2026 with lists of eligible universities and accepted Polish/English certificates. Scholars receive a monthly stipend and tuition-free study at the host university.

en: Full master's in Poland, tuition-free with a monthly stipend
Polish- or English-taught programmes at public universities
Development-aid programme for Eastern Partnership and other Polish Aid countries

eligibility.en: Citizens of the Polish Aid countries listed in the call (Eastern Partnership countries such as Georgia are typically included), holding a bachelor's degree, applying to a master's at an eligible Polish university, with proof of Polish or English proficiency from the accepted certificate list.

en: Check NAWA's Banach page in spring 2027 for the call and country list.
Choose a master's programme at a university on the call's list (Polish- or English-taught).
Prepare diploma, transcripts, language certificate and motivation materials.
Submit the application in NAWA's online system before the deadline; await results and university admission.

costs.en: Monthly stipend and tuition-free study under NAWA's regulations for natural persons (amounts set in the call).

score_reason: Funded master's targeted at countries like Georgia; date estimated
